# AssetRounds Expansion V23 — Architecture Blueprint

<!-- V23_PACKAGE_MANIFEST_START -->
## V23 package manifest

Canonical logical hashing: decode UTF-8 with no BOM; normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF; remove the package-manifest start-marker line, every enclosed byte through the package-manifest end-marker line, and the immediately following LF when present; strip trailing SP and TAB from every remaining line; normalize to exactly one final LF; SHA-256 the resulting UTF-8 bytes; encode lowercase hexadecimal. Canonical package hashing uses `V23PackageDigestV2`: require exactly one marker-delimited manifest in each file and require all four blocks to be byte-identical; replace only the 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters in the manifest's Package digest value with 64 ASCII zeroes; normalize that zeroed block to LF, no trailing SP/TAB, and exactly one final LF; then SHA-256 `ASCII("V23PackageDigestV2") + 0x00 + UTF8(zeroedCanonicalManifestBlock) + 0x00` followed by, in ordinal-filename order, `UTF8(filename) + 0x00 + ASCII(lowercaseLogicalDigest) + 0x00`. The package digest therefore binds every visible manifest byte except its self-referential value. A verifier must compare the exact canonical block, not search for digest substrings. A hash proves integrity against a separately trusted expected digest; it is not a signature or independent authenticity claim.

Canonical structural hashing uses JSON arrays, JSON string escaping, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8 without BOM, SHA-256, and lowercase hexadecimal. Every array-valued absence is JSON `[]`; Markdown `NONE` is display-only and never enters structural JSON. Register order is the published topological order with key order `id,title,classification,status,directPrerequisites,lineage`; graph uses that order with `id,directPrerequisites`; lineage is ascending numeric phase/card ID with `predecessor` (JSON null for added cards), `successor,disposition`. Impact uses topological order and `id,aggregateAcceptanceMemberships,invalidationConsumers,optionalCapabilityProviders,conformanceSubjects`. Relations first iterate dossier cards in published topological register order and emit base rows in fixed kind order aggregate, invalidation, conformance, contract-input, optional, predecessor provenance; then append dependency-disposition `PROVENANCE_REFERENCE` rows in the exact §6D ledger order. All relation rows use key order `source,kind,target,evidence,activation,fallback,invalidates,authority`. Contract facets retain contract-input relation order and key order `source,target,selector,sourceAuthorityRefs,activation,fallback`; source-authority refs are lexically sorted. Selectors use their published seven-row order with `id,members,consumers,predicate`. Dependency dispositions use published topological successor-card order then inherited predecessor-list order with `predecessorConsumer,predecessorProvider,currentConsumer,currentProvider,disposition,authority`. Member arrays retain their published order.

## 0. V23 execution amendment — scope-neutral operating rules

This amendment is authoritative over inherited V22 execution wording. V23 adds no product feature, foundation, persistent schema, public claim, route, root, or release platform. All 146 V22 cards and their product semantics remain intact; only execution governance changes.

### 0.1 Parallel operation with active Phase 10

V23 may begin while Phase 10 is still active. Both efforts use the same AssetRounds GitHub repository and remote, but each must use a distinct branch and a distinct Git worktree. They must never write through the same checkout. Before mutation, record the fetched remote identity, both heads, their merge base, dirty/untracked state, active worktrees, and a path-ownership ledger.

Phase 10 owns its current brand, shared-component, vocabulary, accessibility, snapshot, and accepted-state evidence paths until it closes. V23 may immediately implement dependency-ready work whose hydrated write fence is disjoint from those paths. A V23 card that reaches a Phase 10-owned path pauses only that lane; unrelated V23 work continues. Do not duplicate, replace, pre-empt, or independently freeze unfinished Phase 10 authority.

Use `phase/v23-expansion` in an adjacent `AssetRounds-v23-expansion` worktree. Phase 10 keeps its existing branch/worktree. When Phase 10 is accepted, integrate it to the repository's designated integration base first. Then fetch and non-force merge that accepted descendant into `phase/v23-expansion`. Resolve brand/shared-UI conflicts in favor of accepted Phase 10 authority while preserving V23 product behavior. Record the merge base, both parent heads, conflict paths, resolutions, and targeted reproof. Never force-push, reset, clean, overwrite, or discard either effort.

V23 may not claim final application, brand, visual, accessibility, archive, or release acceptance until accepted Phase 10 is incorporated. After incorporation, run affected-state proof for V23's changed states and one exact-candidate application closure. Do not repeat the original Phase 10 67-state freeze unless an accepted Phase 10 authority digest itself changed or the affected-state inventory proves those states were modified.

### 0.2 Dual-pool CI capacity: five standard GitHub plus three GetMac

The repository may use up to eight concurrent CI jobs when capacity is available:

- `STANDARD_GITHUB`: at most five concurrently executing standard GitHub-hosted jobs.
- `GETMAC`: at most three concurrently executing GetMac jobs using the repository's verified runner labels and configuration.
- Combined ceiling: at most eight concurrently executing jobs, with every job charged to exactly one pool.

Queue rather than exceed either pool. Matrix `max-parallel`, workflow concurrency, and the simplest available native runner controls are preferred. Do not build a custom scheduler, lease protocol, service, or additional workflow merely to reproduce a limit already enforced by the selected platform. Add a small repository controller only if current workflow inventory proves native controls cannot enforce the two ceilings across the applicable workflows.

At activation, inspect current workflow files, runner labels, repository/organization limits, active runs, and GetMac availability. Never infer that GetMac is configured from this plan alone. If GetMac is unavailable, continue with zero to five standard GitHub jobs; GetMac absence is reduced capacity, not a product blocker. If standard GitHub capacity is unavailable, use up to three verified GetMac jobs where compatible. Unknown or unclassified occupancy blocks only new dispatch into that pool until reconciled.

Use the pools for independent test shards, never concurrent source integration. Prefer one build feeding compatible test shards when immutable head/tree, toolchain, configuration, fixtures, and artifacts match. Keep official acceptance fail-fast and separate from the non-accepting diagnostic sweep.

### 0.3 Goal discipline and anti-overengineering guard

Implement the smallest production-quality change that satisfies the active V23 card and its declared acceptance evidence. Every changed path must map to a current card requirement, demonstrated causal correction, or necessary integration resolution. Do not add speculative features, generic frameworks, future-market behavior, duplicate abstractions, new roots, parallel stores/writers/renderers/importers/design systems, or unrelated cleanup.

Reuse the accepted repository's existing architecture and Phase 10 brand system. Extract or generalize only when the current requirement needs it, at least two current consumers demonstrably share the behavior, or an existing V23 contract explicitly requires the seam. Prefer local changes, existing platform APIs, deterministic fixtures, and targeted tests. Stop expanding a solution when the stated behavior is implemented, its edge cases are covered, and its declared acceptance evidence is green.

Do not turn planning contracts into shipping types or runtime machinery unless a card's actual implementation requires them. Planning receipts may remain evidence documents or CI artifacts. No requirement is satisfied by prose alone, but not every planning noun requires a Swift type.

### 0.4 Standing implementation authorization

The owner grants standing authorization for all in-scope, dependency-ready V23 implementation, bounded refactoring required by that implementation, tests, causal corrections, local commits, dedicated worktrees/branches, ordinary pushes, pull-request updates, and CI dispatch within the two-pool limits. Codex must continue autonomously through eligible work without requesting routine phase-by-phase approval.

This standing authorization does not permit destructive loss of user work, force-pushes, history rewrites, secret creation or disclosure, purchases or billing changes, runner-account provisioning, protected-branch/security-policy changes, public communication, App Store submission/promotion, legal declarations, or fabricated physical-device/external evidence. An unavailable external condition blocks only its affected lane; record it precisely and continue all unrelated READY work.

### 0.5 Completion and integration rule

Phase 10 and V23 converge into one AssetRounds application in the same repository. There is no second app and no long-lived fork. Phase 10 establishes the accepted brand/shared-UI baseline; V23 adds the preserved V22 product scope on top. Final V23 acceptance requires the combined exact candidate, no unresolved ownership conflicts, no duplicate systems, accepted affected-state brand/accessibility proof, and the existing V23 release gates.

**Package:** AssetRounds Expansion V23
**Frozen:** 2026-08-25
**Authority role:** Architecture, policies, contracts, ownership, lifecycle, integration seams, and exactly one current dossier per V23 card.

## 1. How to use this Blueprint

Read §§2–7 once at V23 activation and after an authority-digest change. For a card, load its Foundation register row, this card dossier, referenced global clauses/contracts/journeys, direct-prerequisite evidence summaries—including the exact P00-C03→P06 nonrelease exception where applicable, and the exact embedded V21 predecessor dossier when present. V21 material is embedded provenance; V23 corrections and current metadata control. P00-C05 generates a digest-closed `HydratedCardExecutionSpecV2`; it is an execution projection, not a fifth planning deliverable.


## 2. Normative V23 architecture

### 2.1 One application, not an expansion beside it

V23 modifies AssetRounds as one coherent iPhone application. It preserves the accepted four roots, local-first behavior, accepted S10.6 brand system, one workspace model, one serialized writer, one evidence/content authority, one deterministic document renderer, one archive/parser kernel, one import/bulk engine, one search/rebuild system, one route registry, one typed settings/availability system, and one recovery/Erase policy. Added capabilities register into those owners. Creating a parallel store, renderer, writer, contact ledger, communications log, template engine, route system, dashboard root, speech architecture, import engine, or design system is a release-blocking architecture defect.

### 2.2 Dependency and acceptance planes

`CardRelationV2` has seven closed kinds:

1. `DIRECT_EXECUTION_PREREQUISITE` — exact contract/evidence needed before implementation starts.
2. `AGGREGATE_ACCEPTANCE_MEMBER` — accepted receipt required for a milestone or release selector; never scheduling credit.
3. `INVALIDATION_CONSUMER` — evidence to rerun when an owned contract/state changes.
4. `PROVENANCE_REFERENCE` — lineage/research/HIG explanation only.
5. `OPTIONAL_CAPABILITY_PROVIDER` — enables a bounded subcapability; absence selects its explicit fallback.
6. `CONFORMANCE_SUBJECT` — included in a generated corpus without serializing implementation.
7. `CONTRACT_INPUT_PROVIDER` — declaration or semantic-input owner consumed during hydration; it is not scheduling credit unless separately present in the direct graph.

Only the direct graph determines READY. It is acyclic and transitively reduced. `DirectPrerequisiteEvidenceSetV1` materializes every direct edge with exact expected/observed counts. An ordinary edge requires the immutable accepted receipt, unique canonical `CardAcceptanceInclusionProofV1`, matching `CardAcceptanceInclusionProofRecoveryReceiptV1`/currentness, and current-candidate `CandidateAcceptanceCompatibilityReceiptV1(context=DIRECT_EDGE(sourceCardID,targetCardID,edgeOrdinal,directGraphDigest))` or exact successor/supersession disposition. The same receipt is a closed tagged context union; selector evaluation instead uses `SELECTOR_MEMBER(selectorID,memberCardID,memberOrdinal,selectorDigest)`. Supplying selector fields for a direct edge, direct-edge fields for a selector member, or mismatched ordinals/digests fails closed. The only nonaccepting exception is the frozen set of ten P00-C03→P06 edges: `NonreleasePrerequisiteSatisfactionReceiptV1` plus `NonreleaseResultInclusionProofV1` satisfies that edge only for normalized `VALIDATED_SUPPORTED`; every other result remains typed-unsatisfied and grants no credit. Missing, duplicate, orphaned, stale, incompatible, divergent-proof, or extra evidence fails READY. Broad application closure is represented by generated selectors: `P03ShippingSurfaceSetV1`, `P04ShippingSurfaceSetV1`, `P04BrandClosureSetV1`, `PublicCapabilityTruthSetV1`, `AutonomousRequiredAcceptedSetV1`, `ContactPurposeSeparationSetV1`, and `KernelConformanceSubjectSetV1`. A selector proves exact accepted receipts at one candidate; it grants no implementation credit. Foundation §§6A–6D publish the impact projection, selector membership/consumers, exact non-direct relation fallback/evidence/authority rows, and inherited-dependency dispositions; prose cannot add an undeclared relation.

A direct prerequisite is not mechanically duplicated as a `CONTRACT_INPUT_PROVIDER`. The direct edge already binds its complete ordinary acceptance-evidence tuple or exact P00-C03 nonrelease-satisfaction tuple. Contract-input rows exist only for an explicitly named cross-owner semantic facet. P00-C05 declares the digest-bound `ContractFacetRegistryV1` (SHA-256 `b255fe1249ef40cf835fb6717876f20eee864407c206e4ae3baf4a109ab8949f`) below. Every relation has one exact selector: either named evidence families, a named provider facet plus that source's current/rebound source-owned contracts, or all current/rebound contracts declared and owned by that source. “Rebound” means the exact predecessor contract span indexed by `V21PredecessorBlockIndexV1`, never an undifferentiated consumer contract list.

At hydration, `HydratedProviderContractSliceV1` materializes that frozen selector into the exact provider declaration, accepted-receipt, type/member, source-anchor, and compatibility digests and requires zero missing or ambiguous owners. A selector resolving to zero, multiple declaration owners, consumer-owned types, or a member outside the source authority fails closed. This prevents mirrored dependency rows from falsely attributing every consumer contract to every prerequisite while making generic rows deterministic before implementation starts.

### 2.3 Data and lifecycle law

Every persistent kind is registered before first write with declaration owner, writer owner, lifecycle owner, schema/version, migration, backup/replace restore, clone/fork, import/export, journal/replay, search/rebuild, deletion/tombstone/Erase, retention, compatibility corpus, downgrade/forward-fix, and report/history behavior. Derived indexes are rebuildable and never outrank canonical events. Published/finalized records and released portable bytes are immutable; corrections append successors. Stable IDs, captured revisions, actor/time/observation basis, and frozen display snapshots prevent later renames or policy changes from rewriting history.

### 2.4 Mutation and truthful-state law

One `WorkspaceWriter` serializes accepted mutations. Commands bind expected revision and MutationID; effects and receipts commit atomically. Retry after effect-before-receipt returns the same receipt. Reversal is semantic compensation, never row deletion or negative duplication. Draft checkpoints are not canonical completion. UI says Saved/Complete/Restored/Imported/Applied only from a durable accepted receipt. Share sheets, mail/messages, printing, and external apps never prove delivery, availability, printing, or recipient action.

### 2.5 Privacy and contact-purpose separation

AssetRounds remains local-first and keeps its current no-collected-data/no-tracking posture unless a later owner-authorized activation card changes it. Operational Parties, Site roles, contact points, reports, addresses, GPS, photos, evidence, service requests, inventory, voice proposals, reliability history, and work records never flow into dormant measurement or communications contracts. Purchase, app use, support, sharing, or a stored email never creates marketing consent. Ad-network retargeting or hashed-email sharing is a separate higher-risk tracking decision and is not authorized.

### 2.6 iPhone-only release boundary

Every target/configuration/archive must resolve `TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY=1` and `UIDeviceFamily=[1]`. V23 contains no native iPad layouts, split view, Stage Manager, Pencil, iPad screenshots/metadata, iPad keyboard workflow, or support claim. Mac and Vision compatible-app availability remain explicit separate dispositions. If Apple permits the iPhone app to run on iPad in compatibility mode, P05 performs only `NON_NATIVE_COMPATIBILITY_SAFETY_ONLY`: launch, synthetic draft/save, background/return, export/share cancellation, and Erase/data safety. It is not iPad support or a polish matrix.

### 2.7 Inherited brand and HIG

P00-C01 imports only the accepted S10.6 baseline—not the active Phase 10 branch, an in-flight exception count, or copied screenshots. P00-C08 owns forward HIG/premium policy; each feature owns its changed implementation; P04-C29 owns exact-candidate evidence. Every state uses the accepted semantic design tokens, typography, spacing, components, icon policy, motion recipes, content vocabulary, string catalog, and accessibility identifiers. V23 adds affected-state evidence plus one application-wide closure; it does not repeat 67-state Phase 10 shards for every card unless a global brand authority changes.

The HIG taxonomy is a dated snapshot, not an Apple certification. Every current leaf has exactly one disposition and three owners: policy, implementation, evidence. `PLATFORM_HANDLED` still requires app presentation, cancellation, fallback, focus, accessibility, and outcome proof. Designing for iPadOS and iPad multitasking are not applicable. Tab views, scene/window lifecycle/privacy, focus/selection, file management/sharing, voice/privacy, chart accessibility, and the V23 feature states are explicitly mapped. Unsupported Live Photo input is rejected or flattened only through the declared media-import policy—never silently.

### 2.8 Localization

Shipping runtime UI is English `en`; App Store primary metadata is `en-US`. Device locale formats dates/numbers/units without changing canonical bytes. Compiler extraction and `xcodebuild -exportLocalizations` must exactly match `LocalizationKeyRegistryV1`; raw English identity keys, sentence concatenation, missing comments, broken plurals, orphaned keys, and partial shipping locales fail. Pseudo-locales are test-only. User-entered text, identifiers, wire values, and historic reports are never translated or rewritten.

### 2.9 Testing, coverage, and usability

Every feature journey has Golden, Alternate, Hostile, Interruption, and Recovery paths with exact fixtures, endpoints, receipts, offline/permission behavior, accessibility focus, and manual fallback. Automated required paths pass 100% with zero data loss, wrong-entity mutation, duplicate canonical effect, or false success. Physical usability declares at least three non-implementing representative operators before testing. Every declared operator must attempt every critical durability, recovery, lock, and encryption task once and complete it uncoached; no selective assignment or replacement retry changes that denominator. For each other required task, the denominator is exactly five first-attempt sessions across the declared representative-operator pool, with at least four uncoached completions; no retry can replace a failed first attempt. Across all completed task sessions the median Single Ease Question is at least 5/7 and no score is below 4/7; interruption recovery is 100%. This evidence is external test data, not in-app analytics.

Coverage comes from accepting xcresult bundles. Critical writer/migration/restore/Erase/import/finalization/scheduling/portable/app-lock/crypto/stock code meets 90% lines, 85% functions, 95% changed lines. Domain/application logic meets 80%/75%/85%. UI/platform glue uses named semantic/integration tests instead of a vanity percentage. Coverage never replaces hostile, interruption, recovery, accessibility, or physical evidence; performance lanes are uninstrumented.

<a id="v21-v23-rebinding"></a>
### 2.10 V21ToV23RequirementRebindingV1

The embedded V21 material is a source corpus, not live V21 execution authority. For each same-suffix successor, the rebinding parser incorporates only the predecessor card's semantic outcome, included behavior, explicit exclusions, contract and schema requirements, lifecycle and recovery rules, hostile cases, named checks, future-trigger/re-entry conditions, hard-stop boundaries, and acceptance criteria. Future triggers and hard stops are feature-scope semantics, not inherited runtime mechanics. It always discards V21 generation labels, card IDs, classification, planning/runtime status, dependency lists, paths, branch and worktree names, counts, hashes, current repository observations, phase closures, selector rules, state-machine mechanics, release ordering, and activation instructions. V23 current Foundation, Blueprint, Handoff, and exact corrections replace those fields.

References inside incorporated semantic payload translate same-suffix V21 card IDs to V23. P00-C07 references translate through `V21C07RequirementAllocationV1` to exactly one inherited owner among C07 or C09–C12. C13 is never a translated V21-C07 owner; it is a separate added V23 coverage authority. An unallocated, multiply allocated, or ambiguous reference fails hydration. The extraction boundary is the exact indented Appendix A heading `### V21-Pxx-Cyy —` through the line before the next indented V21 card heading or appendix end. `V21PredecessorBlockIndexV1` records byte offsets, source digest, translated refs, discarded metadata fields, and incorporated semantic digest for all 128 predecessors. For every current `VALIDATE_NEXT` or `DEFER` successor, `V21SemanticTriggerBindingV1` additionally records exact source spans/digests for `futureTrigger`, `reentryConditions`, and `hardStop`, their translated evidence predicate, and zero missing/ambiguous fields. Hydration cannot issue `ExecutionHydrationAuthorizationV2` until that exact predicate is satisfied; owner aspiration or elapsed time alone is not evidence.

P00-C05 also compiles `V21SemanticSupersessionManifestV1`. Every incorporated predecessor semantic clause receives exactly one `SupersededSemanticClauseV1` disposition: `RETAINED_TRANSLATED`, `REPLACED_BY_V23_AUTHORITY(anchor,digest)`, or `REMOVED_BY_NAMED_CORRECTION(correctionID,anchor,digest)`. Known C07 allocation, route/closure, Party/contact ownership, installation/punch independence, rating, adapter, review-security, encryption, and count/branch/state-machine corrections must point to their exact current authority. Loading an entire predecessor block without this clause map is invalid; an omitted, overlapping, or multiply superseded clause fails hydration. The manifest changes no source prose and preserves the original block digest for audit.

`NonautonomousTriggerManifestV1` is current V23 authority and makes every validation/defer re-entry decidable. `OwnerValidationRequestV1` and `OwnerDeferredStudyReentryReceiptV1` are owner-signed, one-shot, expiring, exact-card evidence envelopes; they authorize only read-only hydration until the post-hydration fence transition completes, never external outreach not explicitly listed, production activation, release credit, or branch integration. Each declaration row's `sourceDigest` is the exact current Blueprint logical SHA-256 in the package manifest, and its anchor is the literal HTML/section anchor immediately associated with the row. An unknown policy ID, multiple declaration owners, unresolved anchor/source digest, or unresolved mandatory decision invalidates hydration. Feature implementation and exact-candidate evidence owners may differ, but they never redeclare policy.
