    ## 2. Architectural thesis

    AssetRounds remains a local-first, offline-capable field evidence product for small operators. V21 does not become a generic form builder, enterprise CMMS, GIS platform, photometric design tool, cloud collaboration service, analytics platform, or collection of vertical mini-apps. It preserves V20's complete sign/lighting/survey/round/plan/assistance/draft/pose scope through one shared package-driven kernel and preserves all earlier corrections to the assumptions that Site equals customer, one asset belongs to one workflow, all relationships are structural, one “current standard” governs work, severity equals operational state, or future measurement should be coupled to a vendor.

    The permanent shape is:

    1. one workspace writer and mutation/receipt boundary;
    2. one persistent-kind lifecycle compiler and released-data corpus;
    3. one content-reference/immutable-original store;
    4. one package-release and workflow graph;
    5. one finding/repair/recheck/round/search/report engine;
    6. one plan/reference geometry layer;
    7. one brand/accessibility component system;
    8. four stable navigation destinations: Today, Work, Assets, Reports;
    9. one feature-to-claim evidence registry;
    10. one shared party/actor, asset-semantic, criterion, association, and recovery-frontier vocabulary;
    11. one disabled-by-default customer-learning/acquisition measurement contract;
    12. one disabled consent-based communications and suppression boundary;
    13. one five-slot GitHub Actions controller with one accepting truth;
    14. one premium-experience acceptance grammar for native appearance, common journeys, content/feedback, motion/haptics, focus/input, and perceived performance;
    15. one deterministic document renderer with report, label, and customer-safe review projections—not three renderers;
    16. one import/bulk engine with asset/location, Party/contact/relationship, review-response, and one incumbent-file adapter family;
    17. one opaque locator/external-key authority shared by scanning, label output, import, and exchange; and
    18. one local schedule/occurrence authority extended by versioned exception calendars.

    V21 preserves all 111 V20 card identities and adds exactly 17 named cards. P00-C08 remains the inherited sole normative owner of shared applicable-HIG/premium contracts, deterministic scanners/spies, journey fixtures, and build-bound budgets before later UI multiplies; it does not create canonical product truth, another design system, a HIG database, or a premium tier. Planning inheritance provides zero implementation credit. “One store” means one canonical workspace-store lineage behind `WorkspaceWriter` and one immutable-content root/writer; only the explicitly named device-local job, support, preferences, restoration, and isolated recipient-review session stores/adapters may coexist under their sole owners, and none may become a second canonical workspace truth. The same single-owner rule applies to the renderer, route/settings system, import/bulk engine, identifier system, measurement authorities, brand system, localization system, and user-interaction grammar.

    ## 3. Layer and dependency boundaries

    | Layer | Owns | Must not own |
    |---|---|---|
    | App shell | Today/Work/Assets/Reports, route restoration, shared state recipes | package-specific tabs, storage, report logic |
    | Package definitions | immutable vocabulary, facts, completion, claims, report and surface manifests | executable scripts, arbitrary routes, database tables |
    | Domain kernel | asset/activity/survey/occurrence/plan/evidence/finding/repair/recheck contracts | UIKit/SwiftUI views, vendor APIs |
    | Application services | commands, queries, expected-revision writer, finalizers, readiness, rebuild | direct view persistence, network-only truth |
    | Persistence/content | schemas, migrations, journal, indexes, immutable bytes, lifecycle | feature-specific business conclusions |
    | Platform adapters | VisionKit/Vision, PDFKit, AVFoundation, Speech, Core Location, notifications | canonical writes, hidden fallback, claims |
    | Projection/render | Today/due/search, branded PDF/open JSON, share/App Intents | canonical source of truth |
    | Validation/CI | exact-head semantic checks, five-slot dispatch, evidence receipts | product state, diagnostic-as-acceptance |

    Dependencies point inward. Platform adapters return typed results to application services. Packages describe closed contributions. Views call commands and queries. No view writes files directly, no package instantiates its own writer, and no platform result mutates canonical facts without the normal expected-revision command.

    ## 4. Shared identity and activity model

    Stable workspace, entity, replica, package-release, activity, session, occurrence, plan-revision, placement, content, finding, repair, report, and receipt IDs are opaque. Display names, barcodes, QR payloads, external keys, plan page labels, and schedule text are attributes—not identity.

    Historic `ActivityKindV1` remains exactly INSPECTION, SURVEY, PREVENTIVE_MAINTENANCE, REPAIR, and OPERATIONAL_RECHECK and is never reinterpreted. `ActivityKindV2` is exactly those five plus INSTALLATION and PUNCH_REVIEW. If no V1 value has ever been released or written, implementation may publish V2 directly while retaining the V1 compatibility codec; otherwise it performs the explicit P01-C07/P03-C07 adapter/migration. A kind cannot change after activity start. Installation is never inspection, repair, commissioning, fabrication, or release to service. Punch review is never inspection, approval, certification, or a claim that no defect exists. The seven kinds may share assets, evidence, findings, assignments, rounds, reports, and UI components, but each keeps its definition, lifecycle, completion semantics, and claim vocabulary.

    Manual duration/material/quantity/direct cost is an optional append-only activity association, not a new activity kind. It never creates inventory, labor rates, payroll, purchasing, tax, markup, invoices, amounts due, or profitability. Starting a deterministic occurrence may create/link one work packet and one round/session; it does not convert their roles into one ambiguous record.

    ## 5. Persistence and lifecycle law

    Every persistent kind has exactly one declaration owner and one current implementation owner before first write. Enrollment covers closed schema/version, forward migration, atomic activation, backup eligibility, restore replace/clone/fork, delete and Erase, tombstones/orphans, archive/export/open-report, search/rebuild, journal/replay/checkpoints, localization/frozen display, accessibility, privacy/retention, interruption recovery, and downgrade/forward fix. P00-C05 validates provisional complete declarations before first write; P02-C09 compiles accepted rows and derives the universe; P05-C01 recomputes final closure from the actual accepted store so later types cannot escape.

    Large byte work is bounded, cancellable, off the main actor, progress-reporting, collision-safe, and receipt-backed. `ContentReferenceV1` remains the only ordinary byte identity for photos, plan/reference documents, audio, and video. Originals are immutable; thumbnails, OCR crops, waveforms, redactions, and report projections are replaceable derivatives with provenance.

    ## 6. Offline truth

    Offline readiness is a derived exact receipt, never a connectivity icon or cache Boolean. A ready work packet binds the exact workspace, activity/occurrence, assets, package/definition releases, plans, references, localization/claims/report versions, required content digests, storage headroom, capability/manual-path disposition, and openability checks. Missing or withdrawn bytes remain visible. Work completed from a prepared packet must survive cold launch, interruption, restore, and later reconciliation without hidden network dependence.

    ## 7. Brand and accessible-state reuse

    V21-P00-C01 captures one accepted post-S10.6 baseline. Original screens and expansion screens use the same accepted tokens, typography, spacing, components, icons, accepted visual/component accessibility recipes, `StateRecipeV1`, and historic-report policy. P00-C08 owns forward interaction policy; P03-C16 owns localized semantics and identifiers. A package may supply vocabulary and content, not a visual system. Every card emits one bounded impact manifest for changed screens/states and computed shared consumers; full-app brand/accessibility proof runs only when a closed global authority changes or at the exact release candidate.

    Ordinary V21 feature cards do **not** repeat Phase 10 or refreeze the inherited S10.6 inventory. They inherit all accepted state recipes/baselines (67 at the planning observation only), implement the states introduced or changed by inherited V20 and added V21 scope, and test computed affected consumers. After every feature is complete, V21-P04-C27 through V21-P04-C29 inventory, correct, and freeze the original application plus every expansion state as one release candidate. P05-C01 may reuse that evidence across a documentation/handoff-only head only when `GovernedEvidenceReuseReceiptV1` proves product, workflow, test-plan, selector, runtime, dependency, fixture, and matrix identities unchanged; otherwise rerun the affected closure or full matrix.

    S10.6 visual-brand inheritance is immediate. The pre-S10.6 planning observation found no String Catalog, so V21-A00/P00-C01 re-audits the accepted S10.6 baseline. If an application catalog or semantic-ID registry then exists, P03-C16 adopts and extends that accepted owner; otherwise P03-C16 creates exactly one. Before P03-C16 accepts, a card preserves whichever accepted localization/accessibility-ID seam exists, records each new copy/semantic-ID delta in its impact manifest, and creates neither a duplicate catalog nor a new phase-prefixed ID. All later cards consume P03-C16's localization/key/semantic-ID authority and P00-C08's semantic content-pattern authority; P04-C28 removes the shipping legacy allowlist and P04-C29 freezes final closure.

    Required common states are empty, filtered-empty, loading/rebuild, offline-ready, offline-not-ready, permission denied/restricted/unsupported, interrupted, stale revision, validation incomplete, retryable failure, recovery required, completed, and read-only historic. V21-P00-C08 maps exactly `IDLE | ACKNOWLEDGED | RUNNING_INDETERMINATE | RUNNING_DETERMINATE | STALLED_RECOVERABLE | STALLED_BLOCKED | LOCALLY_DURABLE | COMPLETED | BLOCKED | RETRYABLE_FAILURE | RECOVERY_REQUIRED | CANCELLED | STALE_COMPLETION` to shared transient recipes without replacing specialized domain truth. Status is text+icon, never color alone. Required controls are not hidden as advanced.

    ## 8. Privacy, assistance, and claims boundary

    Permissions are requested only when a person deliberately invokes the feature. Camera scan, camera evidence, OCR, dictation, microphone, video, location, photo library, and reminders are independent capabilities with manual fallbacks. Location is one-shot/foreground; custom speech is on-device-only when the device reports support; OCR is local; temporary inputs are deleted after disposition.

    Assistance produces an expiring proposal. It never writes canonical data, starts work, merges assets, diagnoses a cause, or declares compliance. User acceptance is an ordinary expected-revision mutation with a receipt. Manual entry stays feature-complete.

    Lighting claims use OBSERVED, MEASURED, DERIVED, SCREENED, and externally ATTESTED tiers. Photos, EXIF, camera exposure, and internal ambient sensing never become lux/footcandles, CCT, BUG, glare, wattage, adequacy, safety, code, ADA, IES, security, or certification claims. External measurement and criterion screening require complete instrument/plan/context/source provenance and may return inconclusive. The app does not originate a professional or AHJ attestation.

    ## 9. Navigation and progressive disclosure

    The V21 release candidate is iPhone-native (`UIDeviceFamily=[1]`) and has exactly Today, Work, Assets, Reports. It makes no native-iPad claim; a bounded iPad compatibility-mode smoke and explicit Mac/Apple Vision Pro availability dispositions are separate release evidence. Packages contribute closed cards, filters, asset sections, contextual actions, references, and report projections; none may add a tab/dashboard/settings root. Common work is at disclosure level 0, current required context at level 1, and advanced provenance/administration at level 2. One screen has one dominant primary action and at most one advanced disclosure group.

    `NextRequiredActionProjectionV1` is rebuildable and ordered: recovery/stale resolution; missing current requirement; incomplete current item; next ordered round asset; site/round exit requirement; review/finalize; report/next work. It explains and navigates but never acts automatically. `CommonTaskJourneyReleaseV1` freezes semantic route, task identity, primary action, safe resume anchor, and accessibility identity for the bounded common journeys; it never freezes pixels or blocks justified native-platform presentation changes.

    ## 10. Execution, tests, and five-slot hosted-job controller

    One reconstructable controller owns five fixed repository-wide hosted-job slot groups with no placeholder run or authoritative pending-work buffer. Every job-level slot uses `queue: max` without `cancel-in-progress: true`: one member may run, while the inventory-bounded typed pending set is retained rather than replaced and makes that slot unavailable to new controller admission. Pending work owns no active lease or unique authority, correctness does not rely on queue order, and any unbound/above-bound/full-queue state fails closed. Every GitHub-hosted CI, diagnostic, bridge, archive, TestFlight, and release job consumes one slot; a new hosted OS/label blocks until enrolled, while self-hosted capacity is separately classified. The controller/sentinel and trusted bridge use slot 1; explicit `queue: single` is limited to their nonauthoritative workflow-level wake-coalescing group. Every first-stage job has `needs: controller`, each concurrently eligible stage uses at most one job per slot, and later producer→shard→aggregator stages may reuse fully released slots or join only the declared typed pending set after their dependencies resolve. While control still runs, it may emit at most one `DeclaredSlot1SuccessorReservationV1` for an already-declared dependency-ready successor. That reservation is controller planning output only—not GitHub pending-set membership and not a lease—because the dependent cannot resolve `needs` or enter its concurrency group until control exits. After control completes, the reserved job may resolve and be observed/admitted, and up to five jobs may run. `RunnerCapacityManifestV1` therefore caps total hosted in-progress jobs at five. Recompute work from accepted authority on every wake, never duplicate it, and preserve older in-progress work as provenance. Parallel preparation requires disjoint ownership; integration and acceptance remain serial exact-head events.

    The official acceptance pass is sentinel-first and fail-fast. A separate diagnostic pass may continue after contrast/accessibility failures and report all reachable issues, but it is explicitly non-accepting. Deterministic failures receive no retry; an allowlisted typed transient infrastructure signature may use bounded backoff up to the declared maximum of three attempts. Related fixes may share one correction only when the same renderer, demonstrated root cause, and normalized failure signature all match. Unrelated fixes remain separate.

    Run tests by change impact: contract/schema/lifecycle/replay suites for touched persistent kinds and dependent consumers; renderer/state/accessibility tests for affected screens; package conformance for affected manifests; platform/physical-device tests only where Simulator cannot prove behavior; final full release matrix once. An unchanged test is not rerun merely to create activity, but no required dependency-closure test may be skipped to save time.

    Every dossier carries one explicit `ExecutionAuthorityV1` row with exactly `executorActor`, `evidenceProducer`, `decisionOwner`, `externalMutationOwner`, `acceptanceMechanism`, `signoffActor`, and `ownerInputRequiredWhen`. Each actor field is one closed token—`CODEX | OWNER | SHARED | NONE` as allowed by that field—never prose, a conditional expression, or two owners. Conditions and future-owner triggers belong only in `ownerInputRequiredWhen`, owner-only actions, or the existing activation disposition. `CODEX` means autonomous bounded repository implementation/evidence authority. Exact-fence local edits, declared branch/commit/non-force-push operations, and named official/diagnostic CI dispatch/read/poll/log/artifact/evidence operations are governed repository/CI evidence operations under `executorActor`/`evidenceProducer`; they are not business-or-service side effects governed by `externalMutationOwner`, so `NONE` does not revoke them. This never authorizes force push/history rewrite, branch deletion, evidence-bypassing run cancellation, repository settings/secrets/environment-rule changes, or unnamed workflows. `externalMutationOwner` instead governs App Store/TestFlight/signing/purchase, provider/backend/customer communication, public hosting/DNS/publication, ad spend, credentials, production rollout, field attestation, consent, and comparable non-repository effects. `NONE` is an affirmative denial of those effects, not an omitted value. The class defaults are CODEX/CODEX/CODEX/NONE/EXACT_HEAD_CI_AND_HANDOFF/CODEX for IMPLEMENT_NOW, IMPLEMENT_TOOLING_NOW, and PREPARE_NOW; VALIDATE_NEXT uses OWNER as the sole GO/activation decision owner while CODEX may produce evidence or record a conservative nonactivating result; DEFER uses OWNER as the sole re-entry owner while CODEX may maintain its record; P05-C02 is SHARED evidence with OWNER external mutation/signoff; P05-C03 is SHARED monitoring evidence with OWNER rollout decision and SHARED signoff. A dossier-specific row may narrow but never silently broaden these defaults.


    ## 11. V21 foundation integration laws

    ### 11.1 Truth and merge boundary

    V21 supersedes V20 as the one implementation plan, but V20 is not presumed implemented. All 111 V20 cards begin again as same-identity V21 successors with zero credit, and V21 adds exactly 17 independently accepted `IMPLEMENT_NOW` cards: V21-P03-C45 through V21-P03-C51 and V21-P04-C30 through V21-P04-C39. All 111 V19, 111 V18, 110 V17, 102 V16, 100 V15, 96 V14, and 71 V13 predecessors remain transitively represented. The owner's 2026-08-23 direction is the bounded product-scope authority for those exact additions; it is not market, legal, provider, physical-device, or release evidence. Before activation, `C:\AssetRounds\docs\execution\CURRENT_TASK.md` remains authoritative only for active S10 work. V21 starts only after S10.6 is accepted and `phase/v21-p00-foundations` is created from its accepted exact-main head; no V21 planning file authorizes edits on the active S10 branch. After V21-A00, `CURRENT_TASK.md` becomes the bounded projection governed by the authority rule above: initially authority-hydrated only for provisional P00-C01, then generated after P00-C05 accepts. The four planning files install at `docs/design/v21/` with their delivered filenames.

    ### 11.2 Release family and platform truth

    The V21 release candidate is iPhone-native: `TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY=1` and archive `UIDeviceFamily=[1]`. Build, screenshots, accessibility-label device scope, metadata, tests, and prose must agree. P00-C06 freezes one exact shipping orientation disposition: portrait plus landscape left/right unless the accepted S10.6 baseline and a documented field-safety/layout decision justify a narrower set; upside-down is unsupported by default. This is not a native-iPad claim; one bounded iPad compatibility-mode smoke and explicit owner dispositions for Apple-silicon Mac/Apple Vision Pro availability close compatible-platform truth without repeating the complete native matrix. P00-C06 owns early tooling/contracts; P05-C01 runs them against the exact candidate archive/runtime; P05-C02 owns external App Store actions.

    One existing app privacy manifest is preserved and reconciled. Release truth comes from source, compiled archive, aggregate privacy report, dependencies, observed network behavior, permission flows, and store payload together. Apple requirements are date-sensitive and are re-snapshotted at kickoff and pre-upload.

    ### 11.3 Composition and concurrency

    One composition root creates live and test adapters. Import/knowledge direction is explicit: AppUI imports Application; Application imports Domain/Core and owns ports; PlatformInfrastructure imports/implements Application-owned ports and Domain contracts; only the composition root imports concrete infrastructure to assemble UI. Domain/Core imports neither UI nor infrastructure. TestSupport imports application contracts/test-only adapters and is physically absent from Release. Views never create persistence, report, commerce, diagnostic, or file-system services.

    Swift 6 adoption is staged: Complete checking under Swift 5 for every target/configuration, root-cause correction and unsafe-boundary inventory, zero diagnostics, then Swift 6 language mode and full reproof. A blanket unsafe annotation or warning suppression is not a migration.

    ### 11.4 Deterministic test topology and five-slot CI

    `UITestScenarioV1` describes synthetic durable state once; page robots consume semantic accessibility IDs. Direct-state scenarios shorten setup but never replace the small true end-to-end journeys that prove user workflows. P00-C07 owns five checked-in plans: FastPR, ReleaseCandidate, StoreKitRegression, required fail-fast Sanitizers, and the sole permanently non-accepting DiagnosticSweep.

    `FiveLaneControllerPolicyV1` is the same controller over exactly five fixed repository-wide hosted-job slot groups. “Lane” never denotes extra capacity, a hidden queue, or a sixth slot. The controller creates no placeholder run or authoritative pending-work buffer. A slot-group member may be `pending` or `in_progress`; only the sole `in_progress` member owns `HostedActionsSlotLeaseV1`. Pending members belong only to `HostedActionsPendingSetV1` and own neither a lease nor unique work/release authority. Every short-lived wake recomputes from accepted authority, so wake coalescing loses nothing. `RunnerCapacityManifestV1` binds the user's five-total-in-progress ceiling at job granularity. The combined portable sentinel/admission job occupies slot 1; every first-stage job depends on control, each concurrently eligible stage uses at most one job per slot, and later producer→shard→aggregator stages may reuse released slots. A controller may declare one slot-1 successor reservation, but it is not pending-set membership or a lease; only after the controller exits and `needs` resolves may that successor enter the slot group. After control completes, up to five jobs can run. Thus no controller/worker overlap can create a sixth job, and the cap does not depend on an ungrouped runner queue. Official acceptance is exact-head and fail-fast. Diagnostic cells continue independently as PASS/ISSUE/UNREACHABLE but can never accept. Normal `.xctestproducts` build identity excludes selector/runtime execution choices; sanitizer settings require a distinct artifact.

    ### 11.5 Released-data compatibility

    Every shipped store/backup/report/package/exchange version becomes immutable test input. Migration uses isolated copy-on-write generations and normalized semantic comparisons. Historic finalized PDF bytes and frozen display snapshots do not change. Unknown future versions fail before source mutation. P01-C07 seals the policy/corpus machinery; P05-C01 freezes the first public corpus.

    ### 11.6 Site, location, and placement

    `Site` is the physical service, installation, or inspection root—not customer, organization, tenancy, login, authorization, or workspace identity. `LocationNodeV1` supplies bounded hierarchy below it; an asset-binding or reviewed physical-placement change appends `AssetPlacementEventV1`, while a pure location label/code/order change appends only hierarchy history and rebuilds current path projections—never per-asset placement/pose successors. `LocationPathSnapshotV1` freezes what completed work displayed. `PhysicalPlacementEpisodeIDV1` is independent of administrative hierarchy: only `PHYSICAL_MOVE` begins a new physical episode, while a reviewed hierarchy reparent that changes asset bindings may preserve `SAME_PHYSICAL_INSTALLATION` and append successor placement/path events. A homogeneous subtree reparent may use one operation-level reviewed continuity disposition over its exact frozen asset set; mixed/unknown cases require exact per-asset review and `UNKNOWN_REVIEW_REQUIRED` cannot commit. Existing labels remain Site labels and migration invents no customer, contact, party, placement detail, or installation date. Removing a last asset no longer removes its Site. Location archive/delete/reparent is independently previewed and cannot cascade through history.

    ### 11.7 Routes, settings, and availability

    One typed route registry resolves Today, Work, Assets, Reports, scan, search, reminders, App Intents, share routes, settings, and restoration. Routes contain stable IDs and no sensitive/model content. Restoration is a best-effort UI hint over durable session truth and never restarts a mutation or hardware capture.

    One typed settings registry owns keys, defaults, scopes, migration, backup/reset/Erase, localization, privacy, and historic-output effects. Feature availability distinguishes package, entitlement, OS/device, permission, offline readiness, recovery, and temporary failure; it never hides prior work or user-owned data operations.

    ### 11.8 Import, bulk, starter, and reversal

    Import is staged file → bounded parse → typed proposed commands → zero-write preview → explicit writer-backed commit → receipts. Stable keys, not names, identify updates. Bulk operations declare all-or-nothing or explicit chunk boundaries. Scratch source bytes are leased and deleted.

    Durable reversal is a new compensating mutation with expected revisions and receipts, not journal rewind. A Practice workspace is explicit, synthetic, visibly watermarked, installed through the normal writer/store authorities, backed up with its classification, isolated from real work/metrics, and deletable without cross-workspace effects.

    ### 11.9 Diagnostics and support

    Existing local system-health/MetricKit behavior is preserved separately from optional workflow-friction aggregates. Stable operational codes map typed errors to one safe recovery action. The Support and Recovery Center projects existing backup, restore, finalization, report, storage, protected-data, readiness, and diagnostics authorities; it does not create “Fix all,” remote telemetry, or a second recovery engine.

    ### 11.10 Brand, localization, accessibility, and technical identity

    Public brand vocabulary and compatibility-sensitive technical identity are separate. AssetRounds replaces visible legacy product residue; bundle IDs, UTI/extension, storage roots, StoreKit product IDs, schema/wire values, and historic artifact identities remain frozen unless a separate migration explicitly changes them. String Catalogs own UI/purpose copy; canonical formats remain locale-neutral. Semantic accessibility identifiers remain stable across phases and wording.

    The complete accepted S10.6 state inventory is not refrozen per card; 67 is planning provenance only. Each card tests its delta and computed shared consumers. P04-C27–C29 performs one complete end-of-expansion inventory, shared-root correction, and iPhone release baseline freeze.

    ### 11.11 Lifecycle enrollment and semantic schema labels

    P00-C05 validates a provisional complete lifecycle row before the first write of every persistent kind. P02-C09 later compiles those accepted rows into the canonical exact-head registry and derives the universe from real schemas/registries/fixtures; it never retroactively grants ownership or relies on a handwritten count. Dossier `schema/version` values are semantic labels only. Numeric suffixes do not allocate SwiftData versions; P01-C03's globally serialized registry owns every concrete canonical SwiftData successor. Independently versioned operational stores remain under their one named serialized owner and lifecycle authority.

    ### 11.12 Physical validation and owner boundary

    Every pre-P05 hardware-dependent requirement uses `PhysicalValidationDispositionV1 = EXECUTED | REQUIRED_PENDING_OWNER | NOT_APPLICABLE`. Automated code/simulator/fixture/manual-fallback evidence may accept with a prominent pending row and prohibited physical claim; it may never be mislabeled PASS. P05-C02 alone executes or explicitly resolves owner physical rows before release. `RuntimeFileProtectionDispositionV1` locked-device security proof is mandatory for release and cannot become PASS through inference or silent waiver.

    ### 11.13 Card heads, branches, and governed evidence reuse

    V21-A00 runs in a dedicated clean worktree created from accepted exact `origin/main`; it never switches or reuses the dirty/user-work worktree. First create immutable activation implementation head `I_A00` containing only the installed authorities, provisional P00-C01 projection, and allowlisted bootstrap changes. Then emit an external `ProgramActivationReceiptV1` that binds prior main, `I_A00` head/tree, all four document paths/hashes, branch creation, preserved-user-work manifest, actor, and result. If repository persistence is desired, a later authority-only `H_A00` may record that external receipt, but it never names itself and must pass governed no-build-input reuse. A00 is not a card and earns no credit.

    Use one phase branch at a time from the prior phase's verified non-force exact-main integration, except `C04TrustedControllerBootstrapCheckpointV1`. C04 first validates its dormant controller/skeleton with incumbent accepted CI, then non-force fast-forwards the exact incumbent-CI-green but not-yet-accepted C04 implementation candidate to exact main and proves the trusted default-branch controller against that implementation SHA/tree. The checkpoint has one logical checkpoint ID and append-only attempt IDs; a failed attempt already on main remains immutable and a correction becomes its successor. Only then start `phase/v21-p00-foundations-continuation` from the accepted continuation head. This is neither an extra card nor P00 closure. P00 finally closes at C08, P01 at C07, P02 at C10, P03 at C34 only after every required P03 card including C35–C51, P04 at C29 only after C30–C39, and automated P05 at C01.

    In branch templates, `<card-suffix>` is the lowercase `pNN-cNN` portion of the canonical ID, without another `v21-` prefix. Only owner-selected V21-P00-C03 may use its still-open original P00 phase branch, serially, while P00 remains open. After P00 closure it uses `validation/v21-<card-suffix>-<slug>` from then-current accepted exact main. P06 has no integration phase branch: every P06 VALIDATE_NEXT activation or DEFER re-entry always starts from current accepted exact main on `validation/v21-<card-suffix>-<slug>`. A dedicated validation branch never merges, fast-forwards, rebases, or cherry-picks into main or a released candidate; it terminates only in the dossier's branch-head-bound `BOUNDED_VALIDATION_RECEIPT` or DEFER decision receipt after scratch/prototypes are removed and only allowlisted evidence remains. Later implementation is newly authored and reproved on current main and imports no validation code or implementation credit.

    Every `IMPLEMENT_NOW`, `IMPLEMENT_TOOLING_NOW`, or `PREPARE_NOW` card, and every accepted-dependency correction, uses `CardHeadLineageV1` as base `B` → implementation `I` → external `AcceptanceRunReceiptV1` bound to `I` → optional authority/handoff-only descendant `H`. `VALIDATE_NEXT`/`DEFER` studies instead bind their permitted immutable study head to `BOUNDED_VALIDATION_RECEIPT` or a DEFER decision; `OWNER_ACTION` and `MONITOR` bind their immutable evidence/monitor head to the dossier-named receipt. Those non-autonomous paths never fabricate a product implementation head, implementation-CI acceptance receipt, or implementation credit. Dedicated validation/re-entry branches never integrate; pre-closure P00-C03 may remain only as ordinary P00 phase ancestry; P05-C02/C03 use only their separately governed `AUTHORITY_ONLY_RELEASE_EVIDENCE` integration. `I` remains the accepted implementation head; `H` becomes the authority continuation head only when `GovernedEvidenceReuseReceiptV1` proves the `I..H` diff is restricted to named non-build authority/handoff/evidence paths and every governed input digest is equal. A commit is never required to record its own SHA or a future run ID. Those implementation/correction cards integrate serially on the phase branch. Only the designated phase closure may fast-forward fetched `origin/main`, after proving current main equals recorded phase base; `PhaseIntegrationReceiptV1` binds base, closure, prior main, result main, and `FAST_FORWARD_ONLY`. Drift fails closed and requires ancestry reconciliation and affected reproof. Never merge, rebase, or cherry-pick an artifact-bound P05 candidate.

    If a later gate exposes a defect in a dependency whose phase is still open, correct it under that phase's serial successor-attempt law. If the dependency's phase is closed, create `correction/v21-<card-suffix>-<attempt>` from current fetched exact main, hydrate only the original card fence plus computed affected evidence, preserve the original receipt, and rerun the original required checks plus affected downstream closure. `SupersedingCorrectionReceiptV1` binds the old and corrected heads, cause/signature, path fence, reproof, and current dependency pointer; unrelated causes use separate branches/receipts and no card receives second credit. This is the sole non-phase-closure main-integration exception: after re-fetching unchanged main, one `PhaseIntegrationReceiptV1` with reason `ACCEPTED_DEPENDENCY_CORRECTION` may non-force fast-forward the correction head. Any build-input change invalidates an existing P05 artifact/candidate evidence and requires a fresh V21-P05-C01 candidate/archive before the gate resumes.

    Automated P05 closes at V21-P05-C01 and its implementation head remains the immutable candidate/build identity. V21-P05-C02 uses dedicated `evidence/v21-p05-c02-owner-release-<attempt>` branches from current accepted exact main; V21-P05-C03 uses append-only `monitor/v21-p05-c03-<period>-<attempt>` branches from current accepted exact main. They may persist only their dossier-allowlisted, privacy-minimized authority/evidence paths and integrate only by a non-force fast-forward after `GovernedEvidenceReuseReceiptV1` proves unchanged candidate/product/workflow/test/build inputs and `PhaseIntegrationReceiptV1` records reason `AUTHORITY_ONLY_RELEASE_EVIDENCE`. They may not alter candidate bytes, rebuild, relabel, or claim a new build identity. Any governed build-input difference rejects reuse and returns through the correction/fresh-candidate law.

    ### 11.14 Hydrated verification roles and deterministic selection

    Before mutation, every selected card has an individually expanded path fence and explicit GOLDEN, ALTERNATE, HOSTILE, INTERRUPTION, and RECOVERY check mapping. Every dossier path is a planning candidate until post-S10.6 hydration emits exact individual file/create/delete/rename/project-membership ownership; a missing or ambiguous fence blocks only that card and never authorizes a glob or directory. `ExecutionAuthorityV1` is mandatory on every dossier and hydrated spec and separately names executorActor, evidenceProducer, decisionOwner, externalMutationOwner, acceptanceMechanism, signoffActor, and ownerInputRequiredWhen. `NOT_APPLICABLE` needs a validated nonmutating rationale; `NOT_RUN` never accepts. Register ordinal—not numeric card suffix or Blueprint source order—is the deterministic tie-breaker. Choose the lowest-register-ordinal autonomous card whose dependency/phase/authority eligibility predicate is true, which has no current accepted COMPLETE receipt, and whose receipt-derived runtime state is PREFLIGHT, READY, or CORRECTION_REQUIRED. The first exception to the current-phase and no-COMPLETE predicates is a receipt-triggered accepted-dependency correction under 11.13: select its successor correction on `correction/v21-<card-suffix>-<attempt>` before any affected consumer regardless of the dependency's original phase, preserve/supersede rather than erase its accepted receipt, award no second card credit, and invalidate/reprove the declared downstream and P05-candidate closure. The second exception to the no-COMPLETE predicate is an auxiliary exact-main release-transport evidence operation, not a new card execution attempt or state. When `ReleaseMutationInputV1` expires or lacks the required margin, rerun the complete P05-C01 candidate matrix from current accepted exact main with no evidence reuse; emit a new immutable build/artifact identity and full-matrix-bound exact-head release transport/build acceptance receipt, then supersede only the expired transport binding. This transport refresh leaves P05-C01's COMPLETE receipt, accepted implementation head, graph credit, and governed product/source tree unchanged and creates no `CardExecutionStatusV1` transition. P05-C02 never rebuilds or relabels a candidate. Any governed source, workflow, test, dependency, fixture, toolchain, or build-input change is not a transport refresh and instead uses accepted-dependency correction and fresh-candidate law. `INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING` is selectable only after its recorded resumption predicate resolves it to the receipt-named state; `HANDOFF_PENDING` is selectable only for its allowed authority/handoff-to-COMPLETE work and never to rerun implementation. Any other resumable state requires the exact transition receipt first. A blocked low ordinal is skipped until eligible; immutable `planningStatus` is provenance only and never drives runtime reselection. Parallel preparation may occur only behind disjoint fences; integration and acceptance remain serial. `VALIDATE_NEXT`/`DEFER` never auto-select; OWNER_ACTION begins only after P05-C01; MONITOR begins only after P05-C02 records RELEASED or PHASED_RELEASE_ACTIVE.

    Hydration expands every cross-card reference to `V21-Pxx-Cyy`; bare `Cyy` is editorial shorthand only and cannot enter `CardExecutionSpecV1`. Within a dossier it may resolve to that phase only when the named contract/owner is unique; any collision or unresolved reference blocks mutation. The generated ownership projection records, for every contract, one declaration owner, one current implementation/first-write owner where applicable, its allowed instance producers, and consumers. Duplicate owners, consumer redeclaration, unqualified references, and lifecycle `NOT_APPLICABLE` without rationale fail closed. Every accepted report-projection contract is a data/section contributor consumed by the sole V21-P03-C06 renderer; no projection renders files or writes the filesystem independently.

    Authoritative persistence/content/report/restore/coordinator construction and mutation errors may not disappear through `try?`, an optional coordinator, empty-success projection, or no-op. V21-P02-C08 maps them to `OperationalFailureV1` and a safe recovery path; legitimate best-effort optional operations must be explicitly classified. Retry presentation consumes the owning service's typed retryability plus V21-P02-C01 idempotency. An unknown failure code shows the safe generic failure/support code and permits no destructive automatic retry until classified. Lack of green exact-head evidence prevents acceptance but is not an owner stop: an official failure first records `ACCEPTANCE_FAILED` with its run/failure signature, may then record the single non-accepting diagnostic sweep as `DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING`, and only then transitions to `CORRECTION_REQUIRED` and triggers its bounded successor correction. Only a non-correctable missing authority or external owner condition pauses it, and unrelated eligible work continues.

    `PlanningCardStatusV1` is immutable provenance (`NOT_STARTED | BLOCKED_BY_ACTIVE_S10 | DEFERRED`) and is never runtime truth. `CardExecutionStatusV1` is a receipt-derived coordination/runtime projection over all 128 rows; its full implementation/CI path applies only to `IMPLEMENT_NOW`, `IMPLEMENT_TOOLING_NOW`, and `PREPARE_NOW` cards plus accepted-dependency corrections, and the auxiliary P05-C01 transport refresh is outside this state machine. Its closed states are PREFLIGHT, READY, IMPLEMENTING, CI_PENDING, INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING, ACCEPTANCE_FAILED, DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING, CORRECTION_REQUIRED, ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION, HANDOFF_PENDING, COMPLETE, OWNER_PENDING, DEFERRED, SUPERSEDED. Every nondeferred row with no current receipt derives PREFLIGHT even when dependencies are not yet satisfied; PREFLIGHT means “unattempted/preflight truth exists,” never “runnable.” For `VALIDATE_NEXT`, `DEFER`, `OWNER_ACTION`, and `MONITOR`, `CardExecutionStatusV1` is only a coordination projection: those rows use the PREFLIGHT/OWNER_PENDING/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED subset as applicable, their dossier-specific activation/disposition/receipt is terminal truth, and they never enter ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION or COMPLETE through this table. Eligibility is the separate dependency/phase/authority predicate above, and READY requires that predicate to be true. Allowed edges are PREFLIGHT→READY/OWNER_PENDING/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED; READY→IMPLEMENTING/OWNER_PENDING/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED; IMPLEMENTING→CI_PENDING/CORRECTION_REQUIRED/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; CI_PENDING→ACCEPTANCE_FAILED/ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; ACCEPTANCE_FAILED→DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING/CORRECTION_REQUIRED/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING→CORRECTION_REQUIRED/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED only; CORRECTION_REQUIRED→IMPLEMENTING/OWNER_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING→its receipt-recorded resumable predecessor/successor state, OWNER_PENDING, or SUPERSEDED; ACCEPTED_IMPLEMENTATION→HANDOFF_PENDING/COMPLETE; HANDOFF_PENDING→COMPLETE/INFRASTRUCTURE_PENDING/SUPERSEDED; OWNER_PENDING→its receipt-recorded resume state/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED; DEFERRED→PREFLIGHT only with an explicit owner re-entry receipt, or SUPERSEDED; COMPLETE→SUPERSEDED only through the accepted dependency-correction law; SUPERSEDED is terminal for that attempt and a successor attempt begins at PREFLIGHT. Every unlisted edge fails closed. Diagnostic evidence can never transition to accepted. `ExecutionResponseV1` events are PROGRAM_PREFLIGHT, CARD_STARTED, PROGRESS_UPDATE, ACCEPTANCE_FAILED, DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE_NON_ACCEPTING, CORRECTION_STARTED, CARD_ACCEPTED, PHASE_FAST_FORWARDED, OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED, and AUTONOMOUS_HANDOFF_COMPLETE; each binds program/card/branch/base/head/tree/state/actor, receipt/run identifiers, blocker scope, unaffected continuation, and exact next action. Prospectively, CURRENT_TASK is a bounded generated projection over append-only per-card attempt/receipt artifacts with size budgets; accepted S10 history is not rewritten.

    ### 11.15 Universal field-draft and attachment durability

    P03-C36 is the one **workspace-scoped field/media** draft/checkpoint and attachment-staging authority for every editable workspace workflow. It consumes P03-C05's content store and P02-C01/P02-C02's writer/receipt boundary; it creates neither a second writer nor a second content root. P04-C01's bounded `SupportFeedbackDraftV1`, persisted only in P02-C08's named device-operational support store so bootstrap support works without a workspace, is the sole exception and is not a general field-draft engine. A scanner rejects every other draft store/queue. A UI durability claim derives only from a durable receipt. Local-only state is never called “synced.” Staged bytes remain incomplete and cannot satisfy evidence, completion, review, report, export, search, Spotlight, support export, integration events, or public metrics until explicit promotion creates the one immutable `ContentReferenceV1` and target mutation receipt. Source scratch remains disposable until atomically claimed into durable staging; acknowledged staged bytes are then preserved through recovery according to C36 lifecycle policy.

    Every participating P04 field workflow registers a closed typed draft purpose/codec and consumes C36 rather than inventing an autosave/media queue. A scene route may remember only stable semantic field/section anchors; it may offer Resume but never restart hardware, commit, finalization, or share. Backup/restore/delete/Erase/replay and entitlement loss preserve the exact user-owned draft dispositions declared by C36.

    ### 11.16 Bounded report profiles, search, and relationship truth

    P03-C06 remains the sole completed-snapshot/renderer/open-contract owner. It defines bounded, versioned internal/customer-safe and summary/complete report/export profiles inside the one renderer; P04-C04 owns editable workspace profile rows, preset UI, preview, default selection, and first-write lifecycle. The complete effective profile digest is frozen into finalized output. There is no freeform HTML/CSS/script designer, arbitrary data field engine, mutable remote template, or second renderer.

    P03-C09 alone owns search normalization/ranking and an explicit searchable-field allowlist. Exact stable/display identity outranks normalized exact token, prefix, token-prefix, and substring; bounded typo behavior suggests but never silently substitutes. Draft text, raw OCR, hidden metadata, support/feedback drafts, and uncommitted bytes stay out. P03-C04 owns explicit work relationships after user decision; derived duplicate/related suggestions may neither merge identities nor close/copy/resolve work. P04-C21 owns a C36-backed batch-scan draft queue and explicit review; scanning itself creates no work or canonical business mutation.

    ### 11.17 Placement pose and plan-rebase ownership

    P03-C37 owns one immutable pose observation family plus one reusable accessible `PlacementPoseEditorContractV1`, not placement hierarchy or plan rebasing. `PlacementPoseV1` uses `OBSERVED | NOT_OBSERVED` disposition, fixed-point normalized angles, explicit `UNKNOWN | PLAN_RELATIVE | TRUE_BEARING | MAGNETIC_BEARING` frame, bounded reason/source/uncertainty, exact placement event plus `PhysicalPlacementEpisodeIDV1`, root-observation provenance/time, and exact plan-version binding when applicable. OBSERVED requires a non-UNKNOWN frame/value; NOT_OBSERVED carries no angle. One current chain tip exists per `(WorkspaceID, AssetID, PoseAxisID)`; every prior event remains historical. Completed snapshots freeze qualified pose display and machine-readable structured values.

    P03-C35 remains the sole location/move coordinator and receipt authority. Only an asset-binding or reviewed physical-placement change appends a placement event; pure hierarchy label/code/order edits do not. An explicitly reviewed `PHYSICAL_MOVE` starts a new physical episode; a hierarchy-only `SAME_PHYSICAL_INSTALLATION` reparent may preserve that episode, while unknown continuity requires review. C35's closed, versioned pure component registry lets C37 contribute pose disposition without committing or issuing a second receipt. P03-C29 similarly remains the sole plan-rebase coordinator/preview/receipt authority and embeds C37's pure pose-rebase component. A same-installation binding change appends a reviewed pose carry-forward successor bound to the new placement event; a physical/cross-site move defaults to NOT_OBSERVED. Visual page rotation never mutates pose, TRUE and MAGNETIC are never silently converted, and only the policy-digested finite orientation-preserving 2-D similarity algorithm may transform PLAN_RELATIVE azimuth; it preserves elevation, uncertainty, and root observation provenance. Reflection, shear, nonuniform scale, perspective, singularity, or excessive residual produces per-pose `REVIEW_REQUIRED`. No GIS, geofence, route, BIM, AR, continuous heading stream, or survey-grade claim is implied.

    ### 11.20 Exact workflow and measurement grammar

    `WorkflowNodeKindV1` is exactly SECTION, INSTRUCTION, FACT, EVIDENCE_REQUEST, BRANCH, REPEAT_GROUP, REVIEW, or TERMINAL. Every node carries one kind-specific payload and exact outgoing cardinality. A BRANCH evaluates one bounded `BranchPredicateV1` over already dominated stable fact/option identifiers and has explicit TRUE, FALSE, and UNKNOWN destinations; no answer is silently false or passing. The AST permits only EXISTS, IS_KNOWN, EQUALS, IN_SET, COMPARE_FIXED, NOT, ALL, and ANY with hard depth/operand bounds. Multiple matches, forward references, missing legal destination, unbounded recursion, arbitrary cycles, regex, or scripts fail package validation. REPEAT_GROUP is a bounded structured body keyed by stable `RepeatInstanceID`, never array position.

    An upstream edit appends `WorkflowPathInvalidationReceiptV1`. Values made unreachable remain immutable history marked `INACTIVE_BY_PATH`, are excluded from active completion/report/search/integration projections, and require explicit review on reactivation; the engine never deletes them silently or creates a hidden-required trap. Package semantic diff and draft-upgrade preview expose branch reachability and invalidation before commit. A session remains pinned to its exact package release through resume, completion, amendment, report, and export.

    `ResponseValueV1` is a closed discriminated union of absent/not-applicable, Boolean/tri-state, single/multiple stable option IDs, bounded text, date/local-time/instant/duration, exact integer, exact decimal/measurement, stable entity/reference, and content reference as allowed by each field descriptor. `ExactMeasurementV1` stores entered mantissa/scale/unit separately from canonical mantissa/scale/unit, with dimension, precision, uncertainty, conversion-policy release, and rounding receipt. V21 implements a versioned allowlisted UCUM-compatible subset—not the full UCUM grammar—using exact rational/affine conversions and ties-to-even rounding. Dimension mismatch, unsupported unit/version, offset ambiguity, overflow, nonfinite values, or Float/Double canonical persistence fails closed. Thresholds use the criterion's normative unit, never formatted display text.

    `ContentPatternCatalogV1` is String Catalog-backed and covers button verbs, alerts, empty/loading/success/blocked/error/recovery states, permission explanations, and support copy. Ordinary feedback stays beside its subject; alerts are reserved for essential interruption or uncommon nonreversible consequence. Known work uses accurate determinate progress; unknown work uses indeterminate progress; a stalled task explains recovery. Do not show blank screens, global spinners for scoped local work, or shimmering skeletons that invent structure.

    Activation of an enabled app-authored action has visible pressed/busy acknowledgement in `<100 ms`; the standard system-control pressed state counts. Disabled controls, decorative regions, and taps with no action are excluded. Durable Saved/Complete/success appears only after the owning receipt and canonical read-back. Every registered long operation binds one `LoadingOperationTokenV1`, its `PerceivedPerformanceBudgetV1` operation ID, an operation-specific loading-presentation delay, a distinct initial-stall threshold, and a progress-heartbeat SLA. Fast work completes without flashing a spinner and without any artificial execution/success delay. Progress accessibility announcements are meaningfully coalesced rather than emitted for every heartbeat. The executable transitions are RUNNING_INDETERMINATE/RUNNING_DETERMINATE → STALLED_RECOVERABLE when retry/cancel is safe, or → STALLED_BLOCKED when a named protected-data/permission/recovery dependency must be resolved. Retry creates a successor token and invalidates the prior token's UI authority; cancel/supersession likewise prevents late focus/navigation/success. A late canonical effect is never discarded or repeated: it reconciles through its idempotency receipt and canonical read-back. Duplicate submission is fenced; an operation completing after navigation, backgrounding, cancellation, changed revision, or replacement by a newer task cannot steal focus, navigate, repeat feedback, or present stale success. Preserve prior content during scoped refresh where safe. Cancel is present only when interruption is side-effect-safe. Specialized V21-P03-C36 draft/attachment states map into the shared transient recipes and remain canonical for durability.

    | `J10_BACKUP_RESTORE_RECOVERY` | Existing backup or recovery need → locate/explain → preview/validate → execute only the protocol's safe noncustomer step | Verified backup/recovery result or truthful safe explanation/blocked remedy; valuable customer data is never destructively exercised |
    | `J11_SETTINGS_ACCESSIBILITY_HELP` | Current productive surface or Settings → change one setting or open contextual Help → return | Setting read-back is truthful and return preserves valid route, draft, scroll, and meaningful focus; stale Help falls back with explanation |
    | `J12_PURCHASE_RESTORE` | Owner-controlled App Store-signed Sandbox/TestFlight environment → purchase or Restore | Store transaction/entitlement read-back is bound to the tested build; no simulated external effect counts |
    | `J13_DELETE_ERASE` | Disposable noncustomer data → preview consequences → explicit confirmation → Delete or Erase | Governed deletion/Erase receipt and absence/recovery truth are verified without touching valuable data |
    | `J14_PRACTICE_START_SWITCH_LEAVE` | Stable REAL/Today state → start Practice → switch/perform bounded task → Leave Practice or Reset Practice | REAL data remains byte/route isolated and return reaches the validated REAL anchor or Today; Leave never deletes Practice |

    `JourneyEvidenceLayerV1` is exactly `AUTOMATED_SEMANTIC | UNCOACHED_PILOT | OWNER_EXTERNAL_EFFECT`. Every ID requires automated semantic route/action/resume/accessibility proof. V21-P05-C02 additionally requires uncoached evidence for J01–J11 and J14; J12 requires owner App Store-signed purchase/Restore evidence and J13 requires owner physical confirmation/Erase evidence over disposable noncustomer data. `CommonJourneyCoverageDispositionV1` names required layers and records per layer exactly `PASS | FAIL | STOPPED_SAFETY | NOT_RUN | NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE`. Every required layer must be `PASS`; `FAIL | STOPPED_SAFETY | NOT_RUN` blocks release, and `NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE` is valid only for a layer the immutable journey release did not require. Freeze typed route, semantic task/primary action, safe resume anchor, and accessibility identity—not pixels. A justified task relocation needs one `NavigationChangeDispositionV1`, compatibility route/safe fallback, build-bound user notice when behavior changes, previous public-release or accepted-pre-release upgrade fixture, and measured no-regression receipt. Visual modernization alone cannot relocate or hide a common task.

    `PerformanceEvidenceTierV1` is exactly `AUTOMATED_SIMULATOR_REGRESSION | OWNER_PHYSICAL_RELEASE`. Perceived-performance evidence binds exact head/tree/build, tier, physical-device or simulator profile, OS/build, power/thermal state where physically observable, fixture scale, measured refresh rate/frame interval, repeats, signpost IDs, p50/p95/max, baseline, and absolute ceiling. Its existing manifest/budget record also carries a baseline-compatibility key over metric/signpost schema, evidence tier, device/simulator profile, runtime class, fixture digest and scale, setup/reset protocol, power mode, and accessibility profile; only an exact key match permits comparison. Otherwise the predeclared absolute ceiling gates and the run establishes a successor baseline. This is a required field clarification inside the inherited performance contracts, not a new contract. Signpost endpoints are semantic and truthful: first useful state means meaningful interactive content or actionable recovery, never a launch frame, skeleton, placeholder, or hidden prewarm. `AUTOMATED_SIMULATOR_REGRESSION` provides repeatable pre-P05 regression proof; it cannot claim physical performance, energy, thermal, camera, or field usability. V21-P05-C02 must execute the required release budget on the oldest supported compatible physical iPhone and resolve `OWNER_PHYSICAL_RELEASE`. Discrete main-thread work is `<100 ms`; each main-thread update/frame during continuous interaction completes inside the measured display-refresh budget while the gesture itself may span many frames, and critical callbacks target `<5 ms`. Cold p95 `TimeToFirstUsefulState` is the lower of two seconds or accepted comparable baseline +10%; if no comparable accepted baseline exists, two seconds alone gates and the first accepted result becomes the successor baseline. Every other regression budget likewise uses its absolute ceiling until a comparable accepted baseline exists; missing or incompatible is never zero, PASS, or an invented comparison. Each accepting metric uses 20 measured repetitions after its declared setup/reset; if p95 falls within the predeclared ±5% boundary/noise band, run exactly one additional batch of ten and recompute over all 30. A still-ambiguous result is `INCONCLUSIVE_BLOCKED`, not PASS and not another same-head rerun. The exact critical-journey run has zero detected hangs. Root switch, local asset/history open, indexed search first result, draft resume, capture preparation/local thumbnail, Complete & Next, import preview, report first-page preview, backup, and recovery each get an executable budget. Memory, disk writes, app size, energy, and thermal behavior use physical baseline plus explicit regression ceilings. Heavy decode/migration/thumbnail/report/search/byte work remains off-main, bounded, cancellable, and signposted through V21-P02-C05/V21-P00-C08. No telemetry or new SDK follows.

    Brand/interaction precedence is closed: accepted S10.6 owns visual identity; V21-P00-C08 owns interaction semantics and common-journey truth; OS-native material and control appearance are platform presentation; V21-P04-C28 corrects demonstrated conflicts at the lowest shared owner; V21-P04-C29 alone freezes the final V21 release baseline. No lower consumer may reinterpret that order.

    ### 11.27 Safe repetition, evidence curation, contextual help, and scene privacy

    P02-C10 owns `EntryAssistPolicyV1`, `SuggestionSourceV1`, `SuggestedInputV1`, `SuggestionValidationResultV1`, device-local `RecentInputMemoryV1`, and one global device-local `HapticFeedbackPreferenceV1` through the sole preferences adapter. Memory is keyed by WorkspaceID and semantic field ID, limited to three visible suggestions per field, 128 total LRU entries, and a 90-day TTL. It is excluded from workspace truth, backup, archive/export, journal/replay, report, search, support/diagnostics, C43, and cross-workspace access; it is user-clearable and Reset/Erase/corruption governed. A package may declare only low-risk enum option IDs or stable local references. Never retain raw free text, contact/email/address, measurement, condition, pass/fail, finding/severity, evidence, sign-off, qualification, timestamp-as-observation, hidden field, or any value that could fabricate field truth. Revalidate at both display and acceptance against current workspace, package/release, field, option/reference, permission/availability, read-only state, and expected revision. Tombstoned, moved, retired, hidden, expired, corrupt, or otherwise invalid entries are pruned or hidden and never become truth. A valid suggestion is visibly source-labeled, never preaccepted, and becomes a value only through explicit review plus the normal expected-revision command.

    C36 remains the sole field draft/attachment staging authority. P04-C02 consumes it to provide bounded multi-photo capture with immediate local thumbnails, independent per-item processing/retry, explicit order, caption, optional `EvidenceAccessibilityDescriptionV1`, and exact role `CONTEXT | DETAIL | BEFORE | AFTER | OTHER`. Before promotion, Retake/Remove discards or supersedes only the staged item under C36. After promotion, retake stages a new immutable original and commits an append-only successor evidence sequence/association through the one writer; remove commits a successor sequence that excludes the current item without deleting its original. Finalized report bytes remain immutable and any changed selection produces a new report version. Arrow/circle/text markup creates reversible derivatives; originals remain immutable. P03-C20 alone owns privacy redaction. Reports consume explicit order/role/description snapshots; no filename, EXIF label, or AI-invented description becomes accessibility fact. Package and global media limits still apply.

    P04-C16 owns immutable bundled/versioned `ContextualGuidanceCatalogV1` and its `ContextualHelpEntryV1` rows. It rebuilds nonpersistent `ContextualGuidanceProjectionV1` from that catalog plus accepted package guidance, requirement explanations, current feature availability, typed route/screen, and support/recovery routes. Catalog/entries are immutable application content superseded by version; the projection is disposable and has no schema migration, backup, export, journal, or workspace identity. Point-of-need help states Why, what is saved, and the manual fallback in short localized copy and reaches the one offline Help surface within two actions. It creates no tab, remote CMS, onboarding database, analytics, required coachmark, duplicate package content, or legal/professional advice. Safety and completion truth stays in the primary workflow. Optional one-at-a-time local TipKit presentation may teach only nonessential secondary features and must be dismissible.

    P00-C02 owns `ScenePrivacyDispositionV1`; P03-C34 presents it and P05-C01 tests it. Each connected scene installs its branded neutral cover no later than `willResignActive`/SwiftUI inactive and removes it only after active restoration; sensitive content never animates through the cover. Customer/evidence/contact/location/report surfaces are obscured in the exact app-switcher/background snapshot path while preserving active-screen usability, drafts, StartupRouter, system sheet behavior, and restoration. The app does not claim it can prevent system screenshots or screen recording. Foreground/background during camera, draft, report, startup recovery, share sheet, and protected-data lock must neither leak the protected snapshot nor lose state.

    ### 11.28 Complete applicable-HIG, native ownership, and original-app premium law

    The Foundation's dated 157-leaf HIG matrix is the complete planning disposition authority. It refines V20's existing contracts and card acceptance only; it creates no contract, card, feature, service, data flow, permission, platform, runtime database, or public “HIG compliant,” “Apple approved,” or “certified” claim. `PremiumExperiencePolicyV1` remains exactly `CLARITY | IMMEDIACY | CONTINUITY | RECOVERY | RESTRAINT`. Apple's Purpose, Agency, Responsibility, Familiarity, Flexibility, Simplicity, Craft, and Delight principles interpret those five values without enlarging their enum.

    Every matrix leaf has exactly one of `APPLICABLE | PLATFORM_HANDLED | NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE | DEFERRED_OUTSIDE_V21`. P00-C08 is the sole normative applicable-HIG policy owner. P04-C27 refreshes the live taxonomy and application-component inventory; P04-C28 corrects findings through the existing lowest owner; P04-C29 proves complete candidate coverage. `PLATFORM_HANDLED` still requires integration evidence. `NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE` becomes invalid if accepted S10.6 or implemented V20 contains the surface. `DEFERRED_OUTSIDE_V21` cannot activate its technology. Beta evidence can never change a disposition to accepting scope.

    AssetRounds owns task hierarchy, content, field truth, action semantics, feedback, accessibility meaning, accepted S10 tokens, the four-root information architecture, app-authored imagery/mark, terminology, semantic identifiers, and report bytes. iOS owns native navigation/tab/tool bars, menus, search presentation, sheets, alerts, controls, keyboards, permission dialogs, share/file-picker chrome, Dynamic Type font metrics, semantic system colors, SF Symbol rendering, system materials, status-bar behavior, native transitions, and platform haptics. Prefer the standard SwiftUI/UIKit component whenever it expresses the inherited behavior. A custom exception remains valid only through existing `NativeComponentDispositionV1`, with the exact native insufficiency, accessibility/keyboard/gesture parity, minimum-runtime fallback, affected consumers, and removal test. Brand novelty alone is not a reason.

    Use native `TabView`, `NavigationStack` plus value routes/paths, `List`/`Form`, role-bearing `Button`, `Toggle`, `Picker`, `TextField`, `Menu`, semantic toolbar placement, `.searchable`, `.sheet`, `.alert`/`.confirmationDialog`, `ShareLink`, `fileImporter`/`fileExporter`, and system permission interfaces wherever the inherited behavior maps. This list is a selection rule, not permission to add absent behavior. The four roots remain Today, Work, Assets, Reports; tab items are navigation, never commands. Preserve each root's path/selection/filter/scroll anchor where representable, native Back and edge-back behavior, and an accessible visible alternative for every essential gesture. Do not create a fifth Search root.

    The exact minimum-iOS-18 and `LATEST_ACCEPTED_STABLE_SHIPPING_RUNTIME` profiles preserve task, component anatomy, data truth, semantic ID, focus, recovery, and accessibility while allowing native rendering to differ. Xcode 26.6/iOS 26.5 Simulator is a pinned stable-toolchain lane; it is not latest-shipping-patch proof. The 2026-08-22 latest-stable observation is iOS 26.6.1, while iOS 27 beta 6/Xcode 27 beta 5 are separately labeled diagnostics only. P00-C06 re-resolves versions at implementation and pre-upload. No beta API, design resource, screenshot baseline, or terminology enters Release.

    Liquid Glass remains a system functional layer on supported stable runtimes. Do not imitate/backport it, suppress native adaptation, stack glass, add duplicate bar backgrounds, mix material families casually, or place app-authored `.glassEffect` on content cards, forms, evidence, reports, or decoration. `usesTranslucentMaterial=false` continues to prohibit app-authored translucent material; it does not disable system material. The built `Info.plist` proves `UIDesignRequiresCompatibility` absent or `NO`. iOS 18 uses its native presentation with identical semantic anatomy; cross-runtime pixel identity is forbidden as an acceptance goal.

    Every visible action uses a concise familiar verb and exact effect. Add, Save, Complete, Close, Cancel, Remove, Delete, Erase, Share, Export, Restore, Retry, and Resume remain behaviorally distinct. “Sent,” “delivered,” “synced,” “verified,” “certified,” and “safe” appear only when that exact receipt proves the claim. Back/Cancel never silently discards durable or recoverable work. One current task action is visually dominant; secondary actions do not compete, and destructive actions remain separate. No context menu, swipe, long press, icon, or overflow placement is the only route to a required action. Toolbars retain the primary action and use no more than three app-authored logical groups before native overflow.

    Every enabled app-authored action acknowledges within `<100 ms`; a native pressed state satisfies acknowledgement. Nearby content keeps truthful local-save, progress, error, and recovery state. Known progress is determinate; unknown progress is indeterminate. Fast work receives no spinner flash or artificial delay. Long work consumes the existing `LoadingOperationTokenV1`/budget/stall/heartbeat/retry/cancel/stale-authority rules. Blank screens, invented skeleton content, success-before-read-back, late focus theft, duplicate retry effects, and repetitive save banners/haptics fail. After a safe local commit the next field remains usable while independent media/report/other work continues.

    Use system motion first. Custom motion exists only to explain hierarchy, continuity, or state; it is brief, interruptible, absent from repetitive field steps, cannot delay or reorder work, and preserves meaning under Reduce Motion. App-authored haptics are sparse, causal, receipt-confirmed, optional through P02-C10's sole global preference, and supplementary to visible/accessibility feedback. They never fire during camera, microphone, or precision-sensor capture and never gain a new engine, sound, or feature-specific switch.

    Every app-authored interactive accessibility frame is at least 44 by 44 points even when artwork is smaller. Adopted release thresholds are 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for meaningful nontext/state boundaries; these are AssetRounds policy based on Apple guidance, not a universal quotation. Prove 200-percent Larger Text separately from AX5, plus long/pseudo-localized/RTL content, Bold Text, Increase Contrast, Differentiate Without Color, Reduce Transparency, Reduce Motion, dark appearance, orientation, Display Zoom, keyboard avoidance, and cutout/safe-area nonocclusion. Validation errors bind their fields; one explicit submit announces one summary and moves focus once. Async work never steals focus. Functional images/charts have useful alternatives and decorative images are hidden.

    Automated audits and screenshots are candidate evidence only. P05-C02 physically proves proficient VoiceOver, Voice Control visible-name parity, Switch Control, Full Keyboard Access, oldest supported iPhone behavior, real camera/media, interruption, bright-exterior use, and left/right one-handed reach. It may report observations but cannot make universal glove/sunlight/ruggedness claims. App Store accessibility labels remain unclaimed until every required common task has exact physical evidence.

    Permissions occur only at the first user-invoked dependent task with localized truthful purpose and denied/restricted/revoked/manual paths. A neutral pre-explanation cannot misrepresent the system decision. System share presentation proves handoff, not delivery. The scene privacy cover obscures app-switcher content without claiming to prevent screenshots/recording. HIG refinement cannot add collection, telemetry, analytics, provider, SDK, backend, account, cloud, or marketing transmission.

    Acceptance captures whole screens for human context but pixel-gates app-owned regions only. System-owned regions gate component role, label/value/trait, selection/enabled state, 44-point target, safe-area/keyboard nonocclusion, expected route/outcome, and accessibility focus/order. `EXPECTED_SYSTEM_VARIATION` requires OS/build/device/settings plus semantic parity; it is never an unexplained screenshot waiver. Static inventories and shared-contract tests precede screen tests; ordinary cards run changed states plus computed consumers. Official exact-head acceptance stays sentinel-first and fail-fast. The same-head diagnostic sweep may continue reachable failures but is permanently non-accepting. Corrections group only an identical renderer, demonstrated root cause, and normalized signature.

    S10.6 inheritance has six closed global invalidation classes: (1) accepted global semantic color/typography/spacing/shape/material token meaning; (2) shared app-wide primitive anatomy or visual/accessibility state recipe; (3) four-root shell/app-wide navigation identity/shared navigation chrome authority; (4) app icon/launch/release-wide visual identity; (5) shared report-brand template/policy; or (6) global state-recipe authority that changes rendering or accessibility meaning across otherwise unaffected consumers. A leaf copy/semantic-label/localization/layout correction, use of an existing primitive, native material difference, or platform-controlled Liquid Glass adaptation does not trigger broad revalidation unless it also changes one of those six. Every change still receives bounded `BrandImpactManifestV1` evidence. A proven global trigger stops for explicit owner authorization before broad S10-style revalidation; no trigger means repeating Phase 10 is forbidden.

    Original AssetRounds and all expansion surfaces form one application graph. C27 inventories accepted S10.6/original states and every inherited V20 and added V21 state together; it does not create a legacy lane or V21 theme. C27 owns application-rendered state only. P04-C26 independently owns external, publication-ineligible App Store/support drafts; P04-C29 already depends on both and is their integration proof, so the current V21 dependency graph is complete. If the observed historical-photo “Add one optional photo…” action label survives accepted S10.6, P03-C16/P04-C28 replace it with a saved-evidence description while preserving the actual Add control's action label and add a semantic regression.

    ### 11.29 Exact V21 scope supersession and independent rollout law

    ### 11.32 Installation and punch-review activity law

    P03-C47 publishes `ActivityKindV2` with exactly seven cases and owns generic activity lifecycle compatibility plus the two bundled package releases. Installation and punch review are independently enableable and use the existing roots, packages, rounds, drafts, evidence store, plans, placement/pose, findings, review, corrective action, and renderer.     ### 11.33 Portable recipient-review trust and reconciliation law

    P03-C48 owns `.arreviewrequest` and `.arreviewresponse` contracts; P04-C35 owns the end-to-end flow. A request contains one deterministic customer-safe report revision, structured-text alternative, manifest, public export-scoped IDs, and one unique response capability. It excludes raw originals, internal notes/open JSON, contacts, diagnostics, local paths, scripts, forms/macros, and stable workspace identifiers. Recipient Review Mode is entitlement-independent, offline, isolated from normal workspaces, and creates a durable bounded response draft only. Closed response outcomes are ACKNOWLEDGED, APPROVED, or CHANGES_REQUESTED; acknowledgment is nonterminal and changes require content.

    The response proof binds the request/package/body digest with a per-request capability. It proves package possession and post-response tamper detection only—not identity, confidentiality, authorization, delivery, legal signature, or nonrepudiation. The responder's name/organization is explicitly self-entered/unverified. Origin import first creates a zero-write quarantine preview; only `ACCEPT_AND_APPLY` rechecks revisions and atomically promotes exact bytes, records external evidence/actor assertion, and invokes existing review/change-request truth. Stale, superseded, duplicate, divergent-ID, unknown-item, or invalid-proof responses never mutate current work. No portal, account, hosted link, email service, response attachment, or automatic finalization ships.

    ### 11.34 Optional manual resource and direct-cost law

    P03-C49 owns append-only `ManualWorkResourceRecordV1`, whole-minute duration, exact-decimal material lines, exact ISO-currency money, immutable snapshots, and rebuildable totals.     ### 11.35 One-incumbent file-adapter law

    P03-C50 owns a closed zero-or-one production adapter registry and pure bounded codec/mapping port. P04-C37 selects exactly one named incumbent/profile from accepted target-workflow evidence when available. If no lawful, versioned, sanitized format exists, it still completes the closed port and synthetic conformance reference but ships `DISABLED_NO_SELECTED_PROFILE` and no integration claim; lack of provider choice blocks only the enabled profile, not V21.
