    ### 11.36 Advanced recurrence and exception-calendar law

    P03-C51 extends, never replaces, P03-C28. Closed patterns are bounded DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY_DAY, MONTHLY_WEEKDAY, YEARLY, and COMPLETION_RELATIVE; there is no cron, free-form RRULE, seconds/minutes recurrence, script, or remote holiday feed. An immutable `ExceptionCalendarReleaseV1` uses Gregorian dates, one IANA time zone, bounded included weekdays, excluded dates/ranges, and included override dates. Included override beats exclusion; exclusion beats base weekday. A schedule binds exactly one release. Business-day and completion-gap policies are explicit, never inferred.

    Every generated occurrence freezes nominal anchor, adjusted due value, time zone, DST repeated/nonexistent-time disposition, calendar digest, and adjustment reason. Started/completed/missed history never moves. A calendar-only adjustment may preserve OccurrenceID and append a new basis; recurrence-rule change retires unstarted futures and creates linked successors. P04-C38 previews unchanged/moved/skipped/cancelled/created/manual-resolution outcomes before writer commit and shows the next ten as a convenience, never as the complete acceptance set. Existing schedules bind an implicit `ALL_DAYS_V1` compatibility calendar with no changed date/ID. No EventKit permission, external calendar, weather, SLA, assignment, or notification-as-truth is added.

    ### 11.37 Native rating and independent support law

    P04-C39 uses StoreKit's native request action only after a REAL workspace has at least three distinct `RatingEligibleCompletionProjectionV1` rows across at least seven days. A row derives only from one local P02-C02 `MutationReceiptV1` whose typed command finalizes an activity and whose canonical read-back is the matching current `CompletedActivitySnapshotV1 | CompletedActivitySnapshotV2` in FINALIZED state; Practice, imported/historic rows, report generation, amendments, duplicate receipts, reopened/superseded work, and nonfinal outcomes never count. Request only at an idle natural stopping point with no capture, draft conflict, loading, permission, error/recovery, commerce, delete, or Erase flow. Record only a device-local policy digest, version/build, attempt time, and `SYSTEM_CONSIDERATION_REQUESTED`; never record whether the system showed a prompt, stars, review text, sentiment, or identity. Persist the attempt before the system call; storage failure disables the automatic request. StoreKit no-op is unknown, not success.

    The app permits at most one automatic attempt per marketing version, at least 120 days apart, and two app-level attempts per rolling year; Apple's own display limit remains independently system-controlled. A persistent Settings `Rate AssetRounds` link may use the exact App Store write-review URL after release ID validation. `Contact Support` stays separate and always available; no happy/unhappy gate, reward, pressure, custom stars/thumbs, diversion, telemetry, or rating-conditioned support exists. P05-C03 may monitor/respond in App Store Connect as an owner operation but never imports review content into AssetRounds or the repository.

    ### 11.38 Competitive-quality correction law

    V21 treats five observed current-code debts as release-blocking consequences of inherited owners: remove every production five-second result delay; persist and reconcile independent multi-photo draft items; replace operational `try?`/nil-as-empty with typed visible recovery; preserve route/query/filter/sort/scroll/selection/draft/focus/capture context across navigation/background/relaunch; and prove audience-safe report/accessibility truth including historical-photo semantics. Test transient states with an injected clock/TestSupport composition, never user-visible sleeps. One indexed/off-main report-availability query replaces per-row main-actor comparison work. Corrections stay in P00-C08/P02-C05/P02-C08/P03-C06/P03-C09/P03-C16/P03-C34/P03-C36/P04-C01/P04-C02/P04-C16/P04-C28 as applicable and create no separate bug-fix card.

    ## 12. Dossier grammar

    Every card below is independently accepted. Each dossier begins with exactly one `Canonical planning identity` row containing classification plus immutable `planningStatus`, exactly one `Execution authority` row, exactly one dependency row, and exactly one lineage row. `Risk routing metadata` (severity/plane) is optional inherited advisory metadata and is never inferred when absent or used to change ordering, authority, scope, or acceptance. The inherited V20 dossiers are carried forward with generation rebinding and the bounded V21 integration clarifications above; their detailed included/excluded scope, persistent contracts, hostile/interruption/recovery tests, evidence, brand impact, acceptance boundaries, and true blocker-only hard stops remain binding. `EXACT_WITH_GENERATION_REBIND` identifies 89 unchanged inherited cards; `REFINED_WITHOUT_LOSS` identifies 22 inherited integration owners; `ADDED_V21` identifies 17 new cards. None receives implementation credit from planning prose. No V21 prose may silently supersede a dossier requirement or widen a path fence. Historical score/workbook/package-envelope language has no authority and is not an implementation prerequisite.

    ## Phase P00 — Truth lock and product evidence

    Bind the exact V21 repository/V20 lineage truth, after authority-only V21-A00, capture one accepted S10.6 brand baseline in V21-P00-C01, and build executable delivery and audit tooling without product credit.

    ### V21-P00-C01 — Accepted S10.6 baseline and V21/V20 bounded delta/lineage lock

    - **Canonical planning identity:** classification PREPARE_NOW; planningStatus BLOCKED_BY_ACTIVE_S10.
    - **Risk routing metadata:** severity P0; plane BASELINE.

      - typed default/validation and DEVICE_LOCAL/WORKSPACE_CANONICAL/DERIVED storage-scope matrix, including migration, same-input idempotence, backup/restore, Reset, Erase, invalid legacy value, and no raw-key access
      - global app-authored-haptic preference default/on/off/Reset/Erase/system-unavailable matrix with zero per-feature keys and identical text/icon/accessibility meaning; never claim detection of physical sensation or an iOS-wide setting
      - every closed availability reason maps to one distinct state/next action/fallback and entitlement lapse preserves prior read/export/backup/recovery/delete/Erase
      - permission-state transition matrix for every shipping capability, including revocation while open, restricted/limited/unsupported, package/entitlement separation, and zero first-launch/install/restore prompts
      - camera/microphone/speech/audio/video explicit-consent and full-duration active-indicator tests across success, denial, cancellation, interruption, backgrounding, and accessibility variants
      - manual fallback remains complete without falsely satisfying a media rule; capability revocation preserves the draft and creates no canonical suggestion or evidence
      - scratch cleanup fault injection before/after staging and accept/reject/cancel/expiry/crash/protected-data-loss/publication boundaries; CAPTURE/IMPORT/SOURCE bytes remain excluded from backup/search/support/diagnostics while C08's allowlisted SUPPORT_EXPORT output lease stages and deletes correctly
      - P04-C16 consumer conformance proves no schema/key/reason/storage redeclaration and no direct preference or canonical write
    - **Hostile/failure cases:**
      - scope leaks between devices/workspaces, reset erases the wrong scope, two adapters own one key, or a migration changes historic output silently
      - permission changes while a sheet is open, protected data becomes unavailable, disk fills, capability API reports supported-but-unavailable, or an entitlement changes mid-operation
      - capture indicator starts late/ends early, consent is inferred from permission, hidden capture continues, or manual fallback is unreachable
      - scratch survives expiry/crash, CAPTURE/IMPORT/SOURCE bytes enter a backup/support bundle, a support output bypasses its SUPPORT_EXPORT lease, or canonical publication succeeds without its content receipt
      - availability hides a prior artifact or one Boolean maps two materially different causes to the wrong next action
    - **Interruption verification:** interrupt before staging, after staging, before each canonical boundary, after the canonical effect but before receipt, and during evidence export; restart must resume or fail closed without duplicate truth.
    - **Recovery verification:** retry the same operation/ID/digest and prove idempotence; quarantine a reused ID with changed inputs; preserve the previous accepted generation and every immutable artifact on failure.
    - **Required evidence:**
      - typed settings registry, storage/lifecycle matrix, legacy-key inventory/migration receipts, and zero-direct-key/write scanner
      - closed availability policy/reason/next-action corpus and essential-operation preservation matrix
      - capability/purpose/permission/fallback/privacy/archive matrix plus first-use and no-first-launch traces
      - active-capture consent/indicator state captures and accessibility evidence
      - scratch lease/fault-injection/leak/exclusion receipts and accepted-content publication linkage

Use synthetic fixtures only and export no customer content or secrets.
    - **Rollback/forward-fix:** Before public data exists, revert an unaccepted code-only delta if safe. After a schema/receipt/archive version is written or a release fixture is sealed, use a forward-compatible migration/fix; never rewrite accepted history or user data.
    - **Hard stop:** Stop on unmet dependency, overlapping unowned work, unknown lifecycle owner, unsupported release claim, a non-correctable missing exact-head acceptance authority, destructive real-customer action, signing/submission/publication, or an unavoidable material owner legal/licensing/privacy/claims/product-scope decision with no conservative fallback. An absent optional gate becomes `DISABLED_OR_DEFERRED`, and unrelated safe work continues.

    #### Inherited mandatory refinement (V18-origin; unchanged in V21) — signed bundled feature policy and C36 handoff

    - Own `FeaturePolicyRegistryV1`, `FeaturePolicyDescriptorV1`, and `FeaturePolicyEvaluationV1`. One schema-validated immutable resource inside the signed app bundle declares stable FeatureID, `ENABLED | PREPARED_DISABLED`, package/capability/minimum-platform requirements, safe fallback, and exact consumers; its digest binds `BuildArtifactIdentityV1`. Missing/duplicate/unknown versions fail the optional feature closed.
    - C05 hydrates the exact policy resource, loader, schema, Xcode target-membership line, and bundle-absence/duplication scanners into the card fence before execution; a broad resource/project directory is never implicit authority.
    - This is build policy, not a second settings/entitlement/availability truth. Only `FeatureAvailabilityPolicyV1` combines it with package, entitlement, OS/device, permission, offline/recovery/workspace state. Policy gates only a new optional operation and can never hide prior read/report/export/backup/restore/recovery/delete/Erase, reinterpret stored truth, or mutate schema/receipt/history. `PREPARED_DISABLED -> ENABLED` requires a new signed exact-head accepted build.
    - Remote config/URL/TTL, cohort/device/user/workspace bucketing, accounts, Release process/environment overrides, UserDefaults flags, downloaded/executable policy, server kill switch, and test override reachable in Release are forbidden. Add deterministic bundle digest/evaluation, malformed/missing/duplicate/unknown negatives, historic-access preservation, reason-precedence, route/intent/Spotlight/settings parity, zero raw policy reads/network fields, signed-archive resource proof, and Release test-injection absence.
    - Clarify scratch lifecycle: unclaimed capture/source scratch remains disposable under this card. Once bytes are atomically claimed/copied into C36 durable staging, C36 lifecycle and recovery preserve them; they remain noncanonical and cannot satisfy evidence until P03-C05 promotion. Crash cleanup may never delete an acknowledged C36 item merely because its source lease expired.

    #### Inherited mandatory refinement (V18-origin; unchanged in V21) — reviewed recent-input assistance and one global haptic preference

    - Own `EntryAssistPolicyV1`, `SuggestionSourceV1`, `SuggestedInputV1`, `SuggestionValidationResultV1`, device-local `RecentInputMemoryV1`, and the one global device-local `HapticFeedbackPreferenceV1` through the sole preferences adapter. Key memory by WorkspaceID plus stable semantic field ID; allow at most three visible suggestions per field, 128 total least-recently-used entries, and a 90-day TTL. It is user-clearable and has explicit Reset, Erase, corruption, migration, and workspace-deletion behavior. The haptic descriptor follows the build/default/lifecycle/no-per-feature rules above and C08 consumes it as optional reinforcement only.
    - Exclude recent-input memory from canonical workspace truth, backup/restore, archive/export, journal/replay, report, search, Spotlight, support/diagnostics, C43 measurement, and cross-workspace access. Never retain raw free text, contact/email/address, measurements, condition/result, pass/fail, finding/severity, evidence, sign-off/qualification, or observation timestamps. Only low-risk closed option IDs or stable local references declared by the accepted package may participate.
    - Revalidate each candidate both immediately before display and again at acceptance against the current WorkspaceID, package/release, semantic field, option/reference existence, permission/availability, read-only/hidden state, and expected revision. Tombstoned, moved, retired, hidden, read-only, expired/TTL, corrupt, or LRU-evicted entries are pruned or hidden; restore/delete/workspace switch cannot resurrect them. A valid suggestion is visibly source-labelled, never preaccepted, never auto-submitted, and becomes a draft value only after explicit user review through the normal expected-revision path. Disabled or empty memory changes no workflow and cannot prevent manual entry.
    - Add deterministic display-versus-acceptance race tests plus tombstone, move, retired package/option, hidden/read-only field, permission change, restore/delete, corrupt record, LRU, TTL, workspace isolation, and stale expected-revision cases. Every invalid case creates no command, receipt, canonical value, analytics row, or cross-workspace memory.

    #### Inherited mandatory refinement (V18-origin; unchanged in V21) — reversal replay and compaction preservation

    This inherited refinement remains binding included scope; V21 changes no contracts, paths, lifecycle rules, named checks, hostile cases, or evidence. Where the V18-origin clause already superseded a narrower predecessor, that precedence remains unchanged.

    - Journal and checkpoint projections record compensating mutations in ordinary forward order and preserve `reversesMutationID`/target-receipt lineage. Replay never rewinds, removes, or substitutes the original event.
    - Compaction may discard a reconstructable intermediate projection only when the surviving checkpoint plus immutable receipt/basis chain still proves reversal eligibility, current state, and audit history. It cannot compact the last required `ReversalBasisV1` behind an eligible operation without an equivalent versioned representation.
    - Isolated replay, backup/restore replace-clone-fork, interrupted compaction, double-reversal, later-dependent-change, and unknown-basis-version fixtures must produce the same semantic current state and reversal dispositions.
    - Erase/redaction follows its own irreversible policy; it never masquerades as reversal or leaves a compensating command capable of restoring purged personal content.
    - Own test-only `ReplicaConvergenceScenarioV1`, `ReplicaDeliveryScheduleV1`, and `ReplicaConvergenceReceiptV1`; mode NONE and production/bundle absence are mandatory. From one accepted bootstrap checkpoint, create destination-owned A/B and A/B/C ReplicaIDs, mutate each isolated store only through its `WorkspaceWriter`, exchange bounded `ChangeBatchV1` pages, and deliver until quiescence.
    - The fixed corpus covers duplicate/reordered pages, bounded gap/resume, partition/heal, concurrent append union, same MutationID same/changed input, immutable-content collision, delete versus late update, concurrent same-field edit, missing/corrupt content then resume, interrupted replay/relaunch, clone/fork source ReplicaID rejection, and a later explicit conflict-resolution mutation.
    - Consume P02-C03's `ConflictIdentityV1`, `ConflictDispositionV1`, and `ConflictResolutionBasisV1`. For an identical competing set, every delivery permutation derives the same conflict key from stable subject/policy plus the canonically sorted MutationID/canonical-input-digest pairs; destination receipt IDs, journal/arrival order, local sequence, and wall time never enter identity or the convergence digest. Every resolution mutation binds the exact sorted competitor pairs, causal/base frontier, and policy version/digest.
    - Convergence is semantic, never byte/order equality: every replica ends with the same normalized canonical snapshot digest, tombstone set, order-independent unresolved-conflict identity/disposition set, content-digest disposition, and observed MutationID set. Destination journal order/receipt sequence may differ. A manual-policy collision converges on the same unresolved conflict with no winner until an ordinary receipt-backed resolution mutation. If that resolution arrives before any named competitor, keep it causally deferred until the entire frozen basis exists. A concurrent competitor outside that basis creates a deterministic successor conflict after the frozen resolution; it never causes one replica to broaden or undo the earlier resolved set. Delete-wins never resurrects.
    - Add two- and three-way conflict permutation tests: reordered/duplicated delivery and destination-specific receipts keep the same conflict ID; adding, removing, or changing one competing MutationID/input digest changes the ID; resolution cites the stable conflict ID/basis and remains an ordinary writer-backed mutation. Exhaust resolution-first, competitor-first, and late-third schedules across A/B and A/B/C until every replica has the same resolved generation and successor-conflict disposition.
    - Exhaust all topological interleavings only under a declared small bound; larger scenarios use checked-in fixed seeds/schedules/digests for exact replay. Add named two-replica golden and three-replica adversarial matrices, duplicate-run determinism, unknown batch/policy/codec, bounded pages/memory, and Release absence. No network transport, server/vector clock, CloudKit, wall-clock arbitration, random CI-only fuzz, or raw SQLite comparison.

    - **Lineage:** V20-P03-C11 — Delivery-neutral change journal, WorkspaceSnapshotManifestV1 checkpoints, bounded compaction, and deterministic isolated replay -> V21-P03-C11; direct disposition EXACT_WITH_GENERATION_REBIND. V20's earlier lineage provenance remains transitive; all inherited requirements remain binding; V21's added scope exists only in named ADDED_V21 cards, and generation rebinding transfers no implementation credit.

    #### Inherited mandatory refinement (V18-origin; unchanged in V21) — broad typed search and bounded query history

    This inherited refinement remains binding included scope; V21 changes no contracts, paths, lifecycle rules, named checks, hostile cases, or evidence. Where the V18-origin clause already superseded a narrower predecessor, that precedence remains unchanged.

    - Search is broad by default with closed scopes ALL, ASSETS, LOCATIONS, WORK, and REPORTS; type-as-you-search uses deterministic relevance/tie-break ordering and accessible scope controls. Every result shows stable identity, location breadcrumb, status, and relevant open-work context without using display text as identity.
    - Consume P00-C08's `SearchPlacementDispositionV1` and present search in its exactly selected inline or Assets/Work-toolbar location; this list is an allowed option set, not permission for the consumer to choose again. Preserve its surface/scope, prompt key, initial focus, default scope, cancel/keyboard-dismiss, result→detail→back continuity, and runtime profile; never add a fifth root. Compact status belongs on Today, trends under Reports, and the asset timeline under Asset detail.
    - `SavedSmartViewDescriptorV1` is a versioned WorkspaceID-scoped canonical search-domain record owned by V21-P03-C09—not a `SettingDescriptorV1` or SettingsRegistry key. It uses the canonical writer/receipt, migration, backup/restore, delete/Erase, replay, and privacy lifecycle declared by this card. Raw recent-query persistence is `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` in V21: the reserved `SEARCH_RECENT_QUERY` scratch purpose has zero production rows, readers, and writers, and restoration clears transient query text. A persisted default/last-selected smart-view ID is separate scalar preference data registered through V21-P02-C10 as its own `SettingDescriptorV1`; it does not turn the saved-view record into a setting.
    - Own `SearchableFieldRegistryV1`: every field has stable ID, source kind, privacy class, tokenization/normalization, result-snippet permission, retention, and purge owner. Allowlist user-visible asset/location/work/report identifiers and individually approved note/comment/history fields. Exclude media bytes, raw OCR unless explicitly committed to an allowed field, hidden metadata, support/feedback drafts, and all uncommitted C36 fields.
    - Own `SearchQueryPlanV1`, `SearchSuggestionV1`, `SearchResultContextV1`, and device-operational `SearchSessionStateV1`. Ranking is deterministic: exact stable/display identity > normalized exact token > prefix > token-prefix > substring > typo suggestion, then stable ID/timestamp ties. Typo is suggestion-only—never silent substitution—with edit distance at most 1 for 4–7 characters, at most 2 for 8+, none below 4, and at most five reasoned suggestions.
    - Within the live search session, query/scope/filter/selected stable ID/scroll anchor survive result-detail-back navigation. Across cold restoration through P03-C34, preserve only validated scope/filter/selected stable ID/scroll anchor and clear the query; neither route nor scene state stores user text. Test case/diacritic/NFC/NFD/RTL/bidi/control normalization, ranking/ties/typo boundaries, 10k budgets, privacy canaries, delete/Erase/amend/replay/rebuild purging, draft/support/OCR-raw absence, and context restoration across rename/move/delete/stale anchors.
    - **Owned/refined contracts:** `SavedSmartViewDescriptorV1`, `SearchScopeV1`, `SearchIndexProjectionV1`, `SearchableFieldRegistryV1`, `SearchQueryPlanV1`, `SearchSuggestionV1`, `SearchResultContextV1`, `SearchSessionStateV1`.

    ### V21-P03-C37 — Reference-framed point anchors and asset pose/facing, immutable observation history, and plan-safe rebase semantics

    - **Canonical planning identity:** classification IMPLEMENT_NOW; planningStatus NOT_STARTED.
    - **Risk routing metadata:** severity P0; plane DOMAIN_FOUNDATION.
    - **Execution authority:** executorActor CODEX; evidenceProducer CODEX; decisionOwner CODEX; externalMutationOwner NONE; acceptanceMechanism EXACT_HEAD_CI_AND_HANDOFF; signoffActor CODEX; ownerInputRequiredWhen a dossier owner-only action or hard stop requires material owner legal/privacy/claims/product-scope judgment or external authority.
    - **Dependencies:** V21-P00-C07, V21-P01-C07, V21-P02-C01, V21-P02-C02, V21-P02-C03, V21-P02-C07, V21-P02-C09, V21-P03-C05, V21-P03-C06, V21-P03-C07, V21-P03-C08, V21-P03-C11, V21-P03-C12, V21-P03-C16, V21-P03-C17, V21-P03-C24, V21-P03-C27, V21-P03-C29, V21-P03-C35, V21-P03-C36, V21-P03-C39, V21-P03-C41.
    - **Outcome:** Add one application-wide, fixed-point, reference-frame-explicit pose model for sign facing and luminaire aim before downstream UI/report workflows invent incompatible direction fields. Pose is an append-only observation bound to an exact physical placement episode and, when plan-relative, an exact plan revision/page basis. Screen/page rotation, device heading, intended design direction, and observed/as-left condition can never be silently conflated.
    - **Build:**
      - Acquire one concrete schema successor through `PersistentSchemaReleaseRegistryV1` and extend accepted writer/journal/backup/delete/search/report/plan/location owners. Do not create another store, writer, plan/rebase engine, sensor service, renderer, or history system.
      - Immutable package-release-owned `PoseAxisDescriptorV1` declares stable PoseAxisID, localized label key, applicability, closed semantic role `ASSET_FORWARD_AXIS | SIGN_FACE_NORMAL | LIGHT_BEAM_CENTERLINE | OTHER_DECLARED_AXIS`, `PoseRequiredComponentsV1 = AZIMUTH_ONLY | AZIMUTH_AND_ELEVATION`, and `PoseObservationRequirementV1 = REQUIRED_FOR_COMPLETION | OPTIONAL`. OBSERVED AZIMUTH_ONLY requires azimuth and forbids elevation/vertical uncertainty; OBSERVED AZIMUTH_AND_ELEVATION requires both values and validates each uncertainty independently. NOT_OBSERVED contains neither angle; it never satisfies REQUIRED_FOR_COMPLETION, while OPTIONAL may retain it without inventing a direction. `PoseAxisRegistryPolicyV1` caps applicable axes at eight per asset/package release, rejects duplicate/retired/unknown axes, and keeps independently maintained multi-head luminaires as C35 child assets rather than an arbitrary axis graph.
      - `PoseAngleMilliDegreesV1` is signed fixed-point storage with initializer-specific bounds: azimuth normal form `[0,360000)`, elevation `[-90000,90000]`, horizontal uncertainty `0...180000`, and vertical uncertainty `0...90000` when known; unknown uncertainty remains explicit. Serialization rejects floats, NaN/Infinity, overflow, and 360°; import may offer an explicit reviewed correction but persistence never silently normalizes it.
      - `PoseObservationDispositionV1 = OBSERVED | NOT_OBSERVED`. OBSERVED requires a non-UNKNOWN frame and every component required by the descriptor. NOT_OBSERVED requires UNKNOWN/no angle/no angular uncertainty and one closed `PoseNotObservedReasonV1 = NOT_YET_OBSERVED | PHYSICAL_MOVE_REOBSERVATION_REQUIRED | PLAN_FRAME_LOST_REOBSERVATION_REQUIRED | OBSCURED_OR_UNSAFE | SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE | USER_DECLINED`, plus source/event time, exact placement/episode, and root observation provenance when replacing a prior observation. NOT_APPLICABLE belongs only to the package-derived axis applicability result and emits no pose event. `PoseReferenceFrameV1 = UNKNOWN | PLAN_RELATIVE | TRUE_BEARING | MAGNETIC_BEARING`; PLAN_RELATIVE is clockwise from canonical unrotated page-up for an exact accepted plan revision/page/spatial-frame/transform digest, never current viewport rotation/crop. TRUE and MAGNETIC remain distinct forever.
      - `PlacementPoseV1` binds observation disposition/reason, axis, frame/value/uncertainty, capture source, observed-at/root-observation event and time, derived-event time/basis, exact `AssetPlacementEventID` plus `PhysicalPlacementEpisodeIDV1`, optional exact plan binding, and evidence references. Intended/design pose remains a linked requirement/reference and never becomes current observed/as-left pose without an explicit observation mutation.
      - `AssetPoseEventV1` is append-only with WorkspaceID/AssetID/PoseAxisID, stable event ID, exact placement event and physical episode, frozen `LocationPathSnapshotV1`, pose/disposition, plan binding, source, predecessor, expected revision, MutationID/receipt, actor attribution, and digest. Exactly one current chain tip exists per `(WorkspaceID, AssetID, PoseAxisID)` and it binds one exact placement event/episode; historical tips/events remain queryable. Correction/reversal appends a successor.
      - `PoseCaptureSourceV1 = MANUAL | DEVICE_HEADING_PROPOSAL_ACCEPTED | PLAN_GESTURE | IMPORT | SURVEY_PROMOTION | PLAN_REBASE | PLACEMENT_CARRY_FORWARD | SEMANTIC_REVERSAL`. A one-shot `DeviceHeadingProposalV1` is ephemeral, review-required, frame-explicit, accuracy/time/availability bound, and expires. Invalid/negative accuracy, stale samples, denial, or unavailable true heading leaves magnetic/manual paths. Stop updates after proposal/background and persist no continuous vector/location stream.
      - Register pure `PosePlacementDispositionComponentV1` in C35's sole `PlacementChangeComponentRegistryV1`; it contributes `REOBSERVE | CARRY_FORWARD_SAME_PHYSICAL_INSTALLATION | MARK_NOT_OBSERVED` without writing or issuing a receipt. A physical/cross-site move starts a new episode and defaults to not observed. A reviewed hierarchy-only same-installation reparent preserves the episode but appends a pose carry-forward successor bound to the new placement event. Unknown continuity requires review. C35's coordinator alone commits the move and one receipt; pose history is never retargeted.
      - Register pure `PoseFrameRebaseComponentV1`/`PoseFrameRebasePolicyV1` in C29's sole `PlanRebaseComponentRegistryV1`. Canonical plan coordinates are +x right/+y down; zero azimuth is vector `(0,-1)` and positive angles are clockwise. For PLAN_RELATIVE azimuth only, apply the accepted affine transform's 2×2 linear part to that unit vector, compute `atan2(x,-y)`, convert to milli-degrees with IEEE-754 nearest-ties-to-even, and floor-mod into `[0,360000)`. Preserve elevation and both declared uncertainties exactly. The initial policy requires finite coefficients, positive determinant, minimum singular value `>=1e-9`, singular-value ratio `<=1.000001`, normalized similarity residual `<=1e-9`, and C29 spatial residual within its accepted threshold; its complete thresholds, algorithm/version, coordinate convention, and digest are frozen before first write. Reflection, shear, nonuniform scale, perspective, near-singular matrices, nonfinite values, or excess residual makes each affected pose `REVIEW_REQUIRED`. C29's one atomic writer mutation/receipt appends reviewed PLAN_REBASE successors; reject keeps the old set. TRUE/MAGNETIC values do not change because a plan changed. Rebase and same-installation carry-forward successors preserve root observation event/time/provenance while recording their own derived-event source/time.

Manual Not observed requires an accessible explicit reason choice; move/frame-loss components supply their exact derived reason and still require review where the governing coordinator requires it. The editor displays required-versus-optional completion truth, forbids promotion with missing/extra components or missing reason, and never writes canonical state: it emits a typed C36 draft command and later an explicit reviewed promotion command. P04-C03/C07/C17/C19/C20/C21 own concrete sign, round, lighting, plan, survey, and scan-to-work screen integration where the selected axis applies.

Later move, re-observation, rebase, package/locale/profile change cannot rewrite the snapshot or historic bytes.
      - Search indexes only an allowlisted current qualified projection and rebuilds from events; timeline shows full history. Import requires stable asset/external key, axis, observation disposition/reason, frame, numeric units, uncertainty, root-observation/derived-event basis, exact placement event/physical episode, and exact plan binding when required. Open JSON emits the canonical structured contract—schema/projection version, stable axis/event/asset IDs, disposition/reason, frame, integer milli-degree values or explicit absence, uncertainty, source, root-observation/derived-event basis/time, placement event/physical episode, and exact plan revision/page/spatial-frame/transform bindings—with optional localized qualified display text. PDF/CSV/structured text emit qualified text such as `90.000° magnetic; uncertainty unknown` or `Not observed — moved; re-observation required`; no format emits bare “east,” “aligned,” “aimed correctly,” or compliance.     - **Outcome:** Define deterministic, privacy-safe local asset-label contracts that reuse the sole locator authority and document renderer, support both fixed PDF sheets and vendor CSV, and preserve manual entry when camera scanning is unavailable.
    - **Build:**
      - `ManualShortCodeV1` using one frozen case-insensitive confusable-resistant ASCII alphabet, workspace-unique random data, check character, version, and display grouping. It is a locator convenience, never authorization.
      - `AssetLabelTemplateReleaseV1` with immutable template/page/grid/cell/quiet-zone/text-bound/render-release/digest data. Initial production templates are closed to accepted US Letter 2×2, 1×2-5/8, 1×4, and one exact A4/roll profile frozen by implementation evidence; unsupported geometry fails closed.
      - `LabelDisclosureProfileV1 = SHORT_CODE_ONLY | ASSET_AND_SHORT_CODE | ASSET_LOCATION_AND_SHORT_CODE`; Party/contact/address, notes, evidence, findings, work history, credentials, and marketing data are never fields.
      - `AssetLabelItemSnapshotV1`, `AssetLabelGenerationPlanV1`, `LabelProjectionResultV1`, and `LabelOutputReceiptV1`; item snapshots bind exact asset/locator revisions and frozen display text. Stable selection order, explicit user order, AssetID tie-break, NFC, bidi isolation, fixed line breaking/truncation, fixed metadata, and a frozen optional generated time make repeat bytes deterministic.
      - `AcceptedLabelGenerationSnapshotV1` persists only the minimal immutable accepted plan needed for exact regeneration: template/disclosure/renderer releases and digests, ordered item snapshots, frozen display values, locator revisions/status at generation, output digests, and receipt identity. `LabelReprintEligibilityV1 = ACTIVE_EXACT_REPRINT | HISTORIC_EXPORT_ONLY | BLOCKED_MISSING_RELEASE`; active reprint requires every locator/binding still active and unchanged, historic export retains exact bytes/digests but visibly warns that one or more codes are retired/replaced and must not be deployed, and a missing compatible render/template release blocks rather than approximates.
      - QR payload grammar `AR1:<opaque-locator>:<check>` with no URL, display name, address, WorkspaceID derivation, account, secret, authorization, or automatic-start instruction. The existing scanner must preview the resolved asset and require explicit Start.
      - One P03-C06 label projection profile using native QR/PDF primitives behind the existing renderer, integral module scaling, interpolation disabled, accepted correction level, white quiet zone, and no overlaid logo. Provide deterministic vendor CSV and accessible structured-text companions.

Identical resend is another handoff receipt, not delivery or new request.

Preview is zero-write. Explicit decisions are ACCEPT_AND_APPLY, RECORD_AS_HISTORY_ONLY, DISCARD_UNIMPORTED, KEEP_QUARANTINED.

    ### V21-P04-C08 — Reusable preview-first import and bulk command engine, asset/location adapters, and deterministic export

    - **Canonical planning identity:** classification IMPLEMENT_NOW; planningStatus NOT_STARTED.

    - **Outcome:** Replace asset-only add CSV mechanics with one reusable bounded import/bulk planner and writer-backed commit engine for location create, asset create, allowlisted exact-key asset update, and placement, while preserving deterministic formula-safe exports and semantic reversal.
    - **Build:**
      - Define `ImportSourceV1`, `ImportSchemaReleaseV1`, `ImportMappingProfileV1`, `ImportRowIdentityV1`, `ImportRowDispositionV1`, and immutable `ImportPlanV1`. Streaming parse has versioned byte/row/column/cell/scalar budgets; source digest/ordinal/canonical row digest and stable external keys determine identity.
      - Preview performs zero canonical mutation/file publication/receipt/index change and labels CREATE, UPDATE_EXACT_MATCH, UNCHANGED, DUPLICATE_SOURCE, AMBIGUOUS_TARGET, CONFLICT, INVALID, UNSUPPORTED, or SKIPPED_BY_USER with stable reasons. Display names never silently match.
      - Initial adapters support location-node create, asset create, asset placement, and exact-stable-key update of an explicit nonfinal allowlist. Exclude fuzzy update, merge, delete-by-import, finalized-field update, XLSX execution, arbitrary transform scripts, cloud spreadsheets, and media URL fetching.
      - Define `BulkCommandPlanV1`, persistent recoverable `BulkSessionV1`, and immutable `BulkCommitReceiptV1`. Commit runs through P02-C01's writer with expected revisions, deterministic plan/chunk/mutation IDs, ALL_OR_NOTHING or explicitly previewed CHUNKED_ATOMIC semantics, bounded cancellation, and same-plan retry.
      - Classify lifecycle explicitly: source bytes and preview are leased scratch/derived and never backed up; an unsaved mapping is derived, while saved `ImportMappingProfileV1` is a versioned WorkspaceID-scoped import-domain configuration record—not a `SettingDescriptorV1` or SettingsRegistry key—and uses WorkspaceWriter expected revisions/receipts plus migration, backup/restore, delete/Erase, replay, and privacy closure; active bulk sessions are recoverable workspace-operational state; commit receipts are immutable canonical audit; imported entities use their ordinary lifecycles.
      - An interrupted chunked session resumes at the first missing receipt. Completed chunks remain committed and are never described as rolled back. Cancellation before a chunk changes nothing; after chunks it returns an exact PARTIAL_COMMITTED state.
      - Discard only uncommitted preview/scratch. Once a batch/chunk commits, preserve original receipts/history and use an eligible P02-C01/P02-C02 semantic compensating mutation—or forward-fix if ineligible—never remove the committed batch.
      - Create deterministic `ImportCorrectionArtifactV1` with source ordinal, stable external key, error code, offending column, bounded correction hint, and retry identity. Create `ExportSchemaReleaseV1` as a round-trip update template carrying stable external key, expected revision, schema release, and only editable allowlisted fields; corrected re-import preserves row identity/disposition.
      - Export inventory/current issues and correction artifacts in stable order with UTF-8/NFC, locale-neutral canonical fields, robust escaping, formula/control-prefix neutralization, and deterministic repeat bytes.

    #### Inherited mandatory refinement (V18-origin; unchanged in V21) — intent exposure, routes, and private indexing

    This inherited refinement remains binding included scope; V21 changes no contracts, paths, lifecycle rules, named checks, hostile cases, or evidence. Where the V18-origin clause already superseded a narrower predecessor, that precedence remains unchanged.

    - Consume P02-C10's `FeatureAvailabilityPolicyV1` and P03-C34's `RouteRegistryV1`; an App Intent, Spotlight item, user activity, or share route cannot invent a second route or availability truth.
    - Separate `IntentExposurePolicyV1` from `SystemIndexingPreferenceV1`. Core Spotlight content indexing remains explicit opt-in and private/on-device. Because `AppIntent.isDiscoverable` defaults to true, enumerate every App Intent and require `isDiscoverable=false` unless the exact policy whitelist enables it.
    - C14 owns the feature-specific `SystemIndexingPreferenceV1` descriptor/policy instance only. Its device-local, default-OFF value is `DISABLED | DEVICE_LOCAL_SELECTED_WORKSPACES` plus a bounded canonically sorted set of selected real WorkspaceIDs. It is excluded from workspace backup/remote exchange, cleared by device Reset/Erase as declared, and excludes every Practice workspace by policy even if an ID is injected. Register it through P02-C10's sole `SettingsRegistryV1`, `SettingDescriptorV1`, typed key, preference adapter, storage scope, migration, reset, backup/restore, and Erase rules; C14 may not create a local `UserDefaults` key, preference store, or second settings schema.
    - Limit V1 to two-to-five safe foreground/read/navigation actions. Defer background mutation, finalization, delete/Erase, import commit, capture, purchase/restore, and export intents. Unavailable or unauthorized intents return one typed next action/manual fallback without leaking whether a private record exists.
    - Test route/availability equivalence, the complete intent enumeration, deleted/tombstoned/withdrawn-package behavior, and proof that non-whitelisted intents are undiscoverable.
    - Own `PrivateSystemIndexDescriptorV1`, `SystemDiscoveryClientStateV1`, and `SystemDiscoveryIndexReceiptV1`. When the user opt-in setting is enabled and signed bundled feature policy says available, use exactly one named custom `CSSearchableIndex(name:protectionClass:)`, never `.default()`, with `.complete` or an explicitly equivalent/stronger P01-C02 policy. This explicitly supersedes the inherited pending-owner gate. One actor/task serializes every mutation/batch across all workspaces. The single client-state blob contains a bounded canonically sorted per-workspace map of opaque WorkspaceID → source revision, projection digest, index-domain/version, and deletion frontier, plus the global allowlist/policy/index-descriptor digests. It contains no display text and never collapses multiple real workspaces into one scalar cursor.
    - Index only the accepted allowlist plus opaque typed route IDs; every searchable identifier/domain includes the opaque WorkspaceID so equal entity IDs in two workspaces cannot collide. Exclude Practice, unselected workspaces, notes/media/address/precise location/customer/person/secret/hidden evidence. No public indexing, semantic/Foundation-model exposure, web markup, or network. The index remains derived, private, on-device, droppable, and default OFF.
    - Disable/tombstone/withdraw/Erase immediately blocks route resolution and journals idempotent item/domain/index deletion. Apple's completion means the request is journaled, so emit `REMOVAL_JOURNALED`, never a false physical-erasure claim; retry on foreground/rebuild. A stale item resolves only to unavailable/deleted without exposing existence/details.
    - Test default OFF, named/protected descriptor, `.default()`/direct/concurrent API scanners, allowlist fuzz, multiple real selected/unselected workspaces with colliding local entity IDs, Practice exclusion, sorted client-state rebuild, protected-data denial, crash mid-batch, tombstone/disable/Erase-one-workspace/re-enable, stale route, package withdrawal, no public/semantic/network flags, and deletion-journal retry. Erasing one workspace removes only its domain/entries/frontier and preserves/reconciles the others.
    - **Owned/refined contracts:** `SystemDiscoveryProjectionV1`, `IntentExposurePolicyV1`, `SystemIndexingPreferenceV1`, `SystemIndexingScopeV1`, `IntentEnumerationManifestV1`, `PrivateSystemIndexDescriptorV1`, `SystemDiscoveryClientStateV1`, `SystemDiscoveryWorkspaceStateV1`, `SystemDiscoveryIndexReceiptV1`.

    #### Inherited mandatory refinement (V18-origin; unchanged in V21) — batch scan and repetitive-capture plan

    - Own `RepetitiveCapturePlanV1`, `BatchScanSelectionV1`, and rebuildable `RepetitiveCaptureProjectionV1`; use C36's typed draft payload for the queue and the existing RoundSession/round-item/writer boundaries for canonical work. Batch mode is explicit. Each offline scan/manual short code records ordered `READY | DUPLICATE_IN_SELECTION | ALREADY_IN_ROUND | AMBIGUOUS | FOREIGN | RETIRED_OR_REPLACED | NOT_FOUND | NOT_OFFLINE_READY | STALE`; preview creates/starts/completes nothing. Review/confirm adds only READY items idempotently.
    - Launch from an exact existing RoundSession or a zero-write revision-bound bounded selection. Per item, commit fields/media/pose independently through C36 and normal package requirements before navigation. `Complete & Next | Defer & Next | Keep open & Next` persists current disposition, next stable item, requirement focus, and resume route before moving; relaunch may offer Resume but never restart camera/scanner/mutation.

Show exact remaining/completed/deferred/blocked counts and Jump to incomplete/flagged; one failure cannot lose prior items or falsely complete the round.
    - Budgets: current requirement from round <=1 action; required evidence <=2 excluding OS camera; satisfied Complete & Next <=1; no re-search between ordered items; decode-to-preview retains <=500 ms p95. Test 1/2/100/accepted-maximum items; camera/manual/plan parity; duplicate/damaged/foreign/ambiguous/retired/stale codes; permission/offline/low-storage/memory; change after preview; every content/next-item interruption; defer/inaccessible truth; retry/remove; oldest-device metrics; and VoiceOver/Voice Control/200%/RTL/non-color/one-handed reach. No arbitrary URL/OCR/network resolution or second queue/session/writer.

    ## Phase P06 — Advanced validation and intentionally deferred expansion

    Keep advanced, licensed, hardware-specific, organizational, GIS, or model-quality work behind independent evidence gates. P06 owns no phase branch: every owner-selected VALIDATE_NEXT activation and owner-re-entered DEFER study starts a dedicated `validation/v21-<card-suffix>-<slug>` branch from then-current accepted exact main. CODEX may emit the typed conservative `NO_GO`/`DEFER` evidence result when evidence is absent, withheld, stale, insufficient, or disconfirming; only an owner may approve `GO` or scope activation. A bounded validation/defer receipt may close the evidence record, but it never earns implementation, autonomous, product, or release credit. Later implementation requires a new owner-authorized card, newly authored and reproved on current main. These cards never block the bounded current release candidate.

      - Keep four materially different future options separate: local asset/inventory and visual inspection; preventive-maintenance/work history; read-only controller/weather/flow data import; and remote controller programming/operation. Evidence for an earlier option does not authorize a later one.
      - Future discovery must identify buyer/operator, Site and asset topology, station/zone/controller/sensor semantics, water source and service area, units/measurement protocols, offline/manual fallback, seasonal/calendar behavior, alerts/flow anomaly limits, connectivity/account/credential ownership, vendor API/license/rate/offboarding conditions, data residency/privacy/security, report/claim vocabulary, and the professional/regulatory boundary.

A GO result authorizes only a new bounded card; it is not implementation credit.

    ## 13. Architecture completion condition

    V21 planning is complete when all 128 card dossiers exist exactly once, every dependency resolves, all 111 V20 cards have one primary same-identity V21 successor, all 111 V19, 111 V18, 110 V17, 102 V16, 100 V15, 96 V14, and 71 V13 predecessors remain transitively represented, all 17 V21 additions exist exactly once, classifications/`planningStatus` values/dependencies/owned-contract inventories match the Foundation, direct dispositions total 89 exact plus 22 refined plus 17 added, all 157 HIG leaf rows have one disposition/owner/evidence path, future-market fixtures, product telemetry, subscriber collection, and marketing transmission are absent from Release, the original app plus every inherited and added feature surface and application-wide release-brand/HIG phase reuse the shared kernel, and no missing workbook/score/machine package is required. V21 implementation remains at zero until the live repository accepts S10.6, captures the V21 baseline, and produces card-specific exact-head receipts.

    `AUTONOMOUS_IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE` requires all 102 product implementation, five tooling, and eight PREPARE cards accepted: 115 autonomous cards total. `RELEASE_GATE_COMPLETE` additionally requires P05-C02 owner dispositions and may end HOLD/REJECTED/WITHDRAWN/BLOCKED without release; `COMPLETE` is the aggregate decision's terminal reporting state, not acceptance of P05-C02 or release authorization. `POST_RELEASE_REVIEW_COMPLETE` requires a real RELEASED or PHASED_RELEASE_ACTIVE edge before P05-C03. `OPTIONAL_VALIDATION_PORTFOLIO` covers P06 VALIDATE_NEXT/DEFER records and is never a release prerequisite. A green diagnostic, planning document, schema definition, research result, or older-head run earns zero implementation credit.
